q.desc: The ancient Spirit of the Sanctuary reveals itself. The powerful glowing heralds the calamity.
The ancient Spirit of the Sanctuary reveals itself. The ominous flash suddenly turns into a fearful blade.
The ancient Spirit of the Sanctuary reveals itself. The rampage destroys countless adventurers.
The ancient Spirit of the Sanctuary reveals itself. Break down the bursting light with all of your might!
The earth melts from the hot gust of air from the Phoenix's wings. Don't fear, and face the hot blast!
The earth melts from the hot gust of air from the Phoenix's wings. Fight the hot flames that burn your skin.
The earth melts from the hot gust of air from the Phoenix's wings.Push back the surging flames!
The earth melts from the hot gust of air from the Phoenix's wings.Pierce the raging flames and avert calamity.
A Giant of disaster appears from the frozen wastes. You must stop the relentless destruction it brings!
A Giant of disaster appears from the frozen wastes. Stop the destruction it brings, and seal it away again!
In the far North, a Frozen Dragon brings a deathly winter. Stand up against this icy threat.
In the far North, a Frozen Dragon brings a deathly winter. Send this cold from whence it came!
In the far North, a Frozen Dragon brings a deathly winter. May your burning spirit melt these lands.
In the far North, a Frozen Dragon brings a deathly winter. End its absolute zero breath and shatter its world of ice.
The Botanical Beast is draining the life from everything around it. Can you stop the ravening monster's rampage?
The Botanical Beast is draining the life from everything around it. Bring judgment down upon the merciless monster.
The cursed armor full with grudge shows itself at dawn. Defeat the despair covered in dark shadows…
The cursed armor full with grudge shows itself at dawn. Fight off the gold shining despair…

dungeons.n: Clashing Thunder of the Emerald Bird

q.desc: A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Evade the deadly bolts to safety.
A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Fend off strikes of lightning and fight back!
A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Fearlessly face its shock and defeat this menace!
A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Once called a God, fight back this ferocious thunder!
The Eclipse Dragon of disaster has awoken. Defeat it before the disaster starts.
The dragon of disaster has awoken. Shake off the death factor released.
The dragon of disaster has awoken. Overcome the death right next to you.
The dragon of disaster has awoken. Open the path to hope before you are swollen by death!

dungeons.n: Battle against the Silent Holy Knight

q.desc: The ancient Holy Knight has quietly advented. Fight against it with all your might!
The ancient Holy Knight has quietly advented. Show your swordsman's pride!
The ancient Holy Knight has quietly advented. Now is the time to use your utmost powers!
The ancient Holy Knight has quietly advented. No one can avoid its instant sword skills!
All flame coalesced into a godlike form. Does this fiery messenger merely present a challenge, or spell the end of the world?
All flame coalesced into a godlike form. In the crackling fire, you hear the diety's demands.
All flame coalesced into a godlike form. It is clear that without victory, all will be reduced to ash…
All flame coalesced into a godlike form. It is ready to burn everything into ashes with his extreme flames!
The winged guardian appears from another world. Their frigid breath brings winter's chill.
The winged guardian appears from another world. The blizzard born of their winds will freeze the world.
The winged guardian appears from another world. Their howls of absolute zero will freeze the world.
The guardian beasts of the Ice Shrine have jumped to the otherworld. Their freezing howls even stop the time!
A mechanical fortress sealed in the otherworld. It is guarded by dread weapons...
A mechanical fortress sealed in the otherworld. The defensive weaponry grows every more powerful.
A mechanical fortress sealed in the otherworld. These weapons of slaughter finally show their true selves.
A mechanical fortress sealed in the otherworld. The uncontrollable machine is ready to wipe you out!
Dragons with mastery over life and death appear. Do you have the will to stand against their might?
Dragons with mastery over life and death appear. Do you have the resolve to stand against their incredible might?
Dragons with mastery over life and death appear. It will take true faith to survive this desperate battle.
Dragons with mastery over life and death appear. Are you ready to fight against the absolute despair?
This cavern has spent eternity in darkness. It has become the nest of winged dragons.
This cavern has spent eternity in darkness. The air resounds with the howls of disturbed drakes.
This cavern has spent eternity in darkness. The enraged drakes have released their true power.
This cavern has spent eternity in darkness. The dragon with no master will destroy the world…
This consecrated ground is home to glittering dragons. The surrounds are unnaturally quiet...
This consecrated ground is home to glittering dragons. His brave footsteps shatter the silence.
This consecrated ground is home to glittering dragons. Howls of rage illuminate only despair.
This consecrated ground is home to glittering dragons. The solemn light will even eliminate the abyss.
Rayas has been ordered to patrol the Isliid Plain. Monsters have been increasing lately!
A certain someone showed up when Rayas was exploring the plains...
Rayas finds something unexpected in the far reaches of Isliid Plain...
Something huge is heading toward Reigrad. The city is in peril. Hurry!
Rayas continues his pursuit. Can he handle this alone?
Rayas is worried about Iris. Hurry and get the supply you were told to!
Rayas heads to support Liese. However, he is curious about Iris.
Now Rayas is headed toward Sophie. Ask about where Iris went.
Rayas is looking for clues of Iris. Now, head to Giliam for more information!
Look for Rem. Maybe she might now something about Iris.
Iris must be here. Now let's find out the truth.
Orders from the Adventurer's Guild is very dangerous. Still, the two head to the ruins.
Rayas is excited to investigate the ruins. But Iris has her head in the clouds…
Iris seems to be acting a bit strange. Rayas asks her if she's doing alright.
The two arrived at the cave inside the ancient shrine. But there seems to be an unexpected guest…
What is in the depth of the ancient shrine? And where does Rayas and Iris's heart lie?
Ragsherum appears, though he should be banished. Has Rayas returned to the world of the past?
Ragsherum, released from the seal, gathers his strength to revive his lord and return the Demons to power.
Ragsherum is not the only demon to have returned.  He makes contact with some subordinates.
With Gormarey as a base, the demons gathered around Ragsherum begin to act.
With the terrifying dragon under his control, a calm smile comes to his face.
The Guild Entrance Exam begins! Defeat the monsters and show Ganan your stuff!
Lute's mom's in trouble! Hurry to the Isliid Plains!
After a nice lunch, it's time for some training.
Rayas and Lute make it to the plains. There, they have a little adventure.
Help set up the Boy Adventurers' hideout. First, make sure the area's safe!
[The Boy Adventurers 2] Rayas reaches the hidden place. It's perfect for a hideout!
[The Boy Adventurers 3] Rayas reaches the enormous footprints. Could this presence be...?
Rayas' journey has begun, but the blazing hot volcanic cavern might kill his enthusiasm.
Fire monsters infest the cave. The heat and the monsters are both dangerous enemies.
The end of the cave is still out of sight. The enemies are getting stronger. Best stay on guard!
Deeper in the cave, Gobls grow numerous. Their nest must be near...
The exit is in sight! But a beast of flame blocks your way.
The path to the Demonseal Tower leads through frigid tundra. Rayas must press on through the snow.
Rayas keeps on, defeating Water-element wielding enemies every step. His resolve never freezes!
Rayas' fever for adventure warms him in wind and snow, but his enemies strengthen with every step.
Even a blizzard isn't safe from vicious sardines! The frigid snowfield is a paradise to fishmen.
The weary, freezing journey continues, but now a fierce warrior blocks the way.
Beyond the tundra lies a beautiful forest, but the green shadows hide vicious foes!
They say sneaky spirits love the deep woods. Proceed with caution, lest they turn on you!
Even at midday, the forest stays dim. At times, beasts howl in the distance but remain hidden from view.
They say there's a thief who preys on adventurers in the woods. Be quick and turn the tables!
The chase leads our heroes down narrow trails. The human bones scattered around offer mute warning.
The Tower has come into faint view beyond the snow, but ancient ruins stand in the way.
Stone enemies appear in the ruins. Perhaps they are guardians from ancient days?
Passing through the white-horse guarded ruins, the neighing of a huge winged horse overpowers Rayas.
Someone else is in these ruins. Follow the footprints!
The footprints lead through a gargantuan gate. It looks dangerous to continue...
Mira leads the party to Fort Goldoa. The tower is in plain sight--the goal is near!
Red eyes gleam in the dark. The fortress has become the lair of bloodthirsty bats!
The party proceeds through the darkened fortress. But where has Ru gotten to?
Perhaps victims of a forgotten battle, skeletons swarm the area. Proceed with caution!
The party finally conquers the skeletons. Now, they sense the power behind the walking dead.
Rayas goes to check out Fort Goldoa with Ganan. It's a great chance to show his progress!
[An Adventurer Grows Up 2] Ganan gives Rayas the lead, but he makes his opinions clear. It feels like the entrance exam all over again!
The party reaches their goal, but something's wrong with Iris. It'd be best to finish up quickly!
The party presses on while dodging traps. The enemies are few but stronger than every before. Stay sharp!
This should be the middle of the tower. It's as if some ominous presence is disorienting everyone...
Further up the tower, the enemies grow even more powerful. What could lie ahead?
This enemy is far beyond any that came before. Rayas breaks out in a cold sweat.
Rayas begins a journey through a new land. It starts with the Dara Desert.
The creatures of the parched heat are fearsome. Keep your guard up!
Beasts of flame come tearing through the burning air. Their spears are sharp and forgive no carelessness!
The party has passed the desert's midpoint, but their trouble is not over. New enemies await!
The harsh desert is almost behind them, but the harshest fight still remains!
The ocean breezes are soothing on the party's burnt bodies. Now, they set sight on the Coroc Road.
The fishmen from the tundra make another appearance. Clearly, they're more powerful in water than snow...
A walk on the beach... It appears the Gramenian soldiers have left this lovely seashore.
As the end of the beach, a single gunman comes into view. He looks mighty confident...
The Gramenians didn't show up on the Sadahl Coast. Perhaps they gave up?
Beyond the coast was a peculiar path born of the great trees. It awakens Rayas' adventurous spirit.
The idyllic scenery belies the danger at every turn. Be ready for surprise attacks!
Progress down this natural roadway is difficult. Attacks can come from anywhere.
This lone path is lined with perfectly outfitted heavy troops. For a simple route, it's certainly dangerous.
The final great tree is in sight. It's the end of the road, but the air is thick with enemies...
Rayas returns to Coroc Road to escort a client. Stay sharp and keep going!
[On the Road Again 2] The two walk happily down the road. But they'd best watch their feet!
[On the Road Again 3] The end of the road is near. Was it a good trip?
After the Coroc Road, the party enters a wasteland of whirling sand. They hear monsters howling in the distance.
The flying sand scatters the sunlight. The mystical veil of light hides dangers beyond.
They approach the middle of the wasteland. Hopefully they make it through without incident...
They say great hunters stalk this land. It's easy to stand out, so choose your path carefully...
The journey through the wasteland continues, but they hear bloodcurdling howls from somewhere...
It looks like Mira and Fen have gained some mutual respect. Time to get through this marsh and reach the tower!
This battlefield is cruel. Along with mud, the rain cuts visibility. The harsh fighting never ends...
The rain never ends in this marsh. Perhaps even the heroes of old felt this rain on their shoulders.
Suddenly, a tree explodes with lightning before your eyes. An act of nature, or evil magic?
A sharp spirit fills the marsh like the sound of thunder. An extraordinary enemy awaits.
The tower appears out of the thunderclouds. It exudes an overpowering aura of silent calm.
The massive corridors continue on. Their seamless design creates the illusion of infinity.
It feels like they've come far, but the path leads ever onward. Is Iris OK?
This girl wields a weapon of mass slaughter. The bizarre sight sends a chill down the spine.
The menacing aura from below grows stronger. Hurry to meet up with Fen!
On the way to Famelle, the party reaches a volcano. A line of shapes approach in the heat haze.
Melia's words twist in the mind.  They lead the party astray on the path to the Beast King.
The Warrior of the Blazing Fists stages a comeback with two fists full of passion. It won't be easy getting past.
After talking through everything, feelings are high. There's no hesitation in taking that next step.
The party feels shaking as they traverse the rocky land. Something massive this way comes.
The party boards the ghost ship to gain Zeorg's aid. Unsettling creaks fill the air.
Iris pays no mind to the eerie surroundings. Mira, on the other hand...
The Siren has a beautiful, if cursed, voice. They say she's even stolen the souls of some, twisting their bodies as well.
They proceed through the gloomy ship. At times they feel someone's gaze, and they have the sense they aren't alone here...
As the investigation ends, pirates show their ugly faces. Perhaps they heard rumors of treasure?
The party enters a verdant forest of giant trees. Its beautiful scenery drips with deadly poison.
The monsters have prepared a rough welcome. It appears this poison-soaked primeval forest has a master...
Cyclopes appear, trampling the trees underfoot. Shields offer no protection from their mighty arms.
The forest air is heavy with damp and heat. Fen's thoughts race, but his face shows no change.
Fallen foes tell of a woman taming the beasts and ruling the forest. What beasts does she control?
The Phoenix's Rest overflows with grandeur and beauty. It would be a lovely sight, if not for all the monsters...
There is a legend in Famelle saying all those who see the Phoenix will find luck. Could it be true?
It seems luck isn't all the great bird brings. With a shriek of wind from above, deadly talons descend.
He rained down mighty blows from the moment he took up the sword. The air around him sparks with electricity.
A heart-stopping aura fills the air. Grad is likely just ahead...
Roy joins the party, and they set out for the Demonseal Tower. Before them, a mysterious light-filled cave overlooks the ravine.
The light filling this cavern shines in brilliant colors. Could it be enchanting the monsters?
It appears Roy has some ideas about Fen. The mysterious light shines over his friend's face....
Roy and Fen have worked things out. Now to make up with Mira...
The party spots daylight, but of course, nothing is that easy. What enemy awaits them?
This tower hosts more monsters than any before. Clearly, investigating it won't be easy.
The violence in this tower is unlike any before. There must be something important here!
An attack comes in an open hall. A trinity of Fire, Water and Earth falls on the party.
The party barely dodges a blow from his greatsword. The blade is as black as night itself.
The crack of a whip breaks the silence. The party must head to the top floor and settle things with Nier.
The sullying of this house of knowledge must not go unavenged! Defeat the monsters and free the library.
Fighting indoors has its own challenges. Best be careful of that fire magic!
Proceed on between the ever-reaching bookcases. Could anyone ever read all of these books?
A splendid knight attacks. This duel with a possessed foe won't have a storybook ending!
Fen seems pleased with the results of his investigation. Meanwhile, the party is being watched by inhuman eyes...
The party reaches the sand sea that divides the east from the west. Their target is yet another tower: Liima.
The heat of the sand sea plays no favorites. The bones scattered about show there are no exceptions.
The heat and heavy sand wear away the party's stamina. Iris' face starts showing the strain.
A blazing god of war awaits his targets. The rising haze of heat confuses the eye...

q.n: An End to the Sand Sea
q.desc: The border of the wide sand sea is in sight. There don't appear to be any powerful foes--perhaps the worst is over.
It appears Zeorg has gone ahead. To distract from his irritation, he treads on thin ice...
The party is tormented by the endless blizzard, but if Iris waits ahead, they can't stop.
The blizzard worsens near the peaks. Enemy attacks and perilous falls are equally dangerous!
A burning passion fills the party's hearts. Not even the frigid air can cool it down!
It seems the trail has started to descend! Perhaps this frozen mountain range has an end after all.
A hidden lake fills this cavern. The tranquil scenery is breathtaking.
There is a dark aura in the otherworldly air. This is no time to take in the scenery!
The future is always uncertain. All they can do is keep going and hope that the truth awaits them at their destination.
Great beasts leap out from the thickets ahead. Get ready for a fight!
The party has reached the very end of the cavern. Here they find the blades of the enemy!
The party follows Zeorg into an ancient ruin. It appears they're almost out of time.
With water on the ceiling and cubes moving through space, this place is not of our world.
Deeper in the ruins, something feels off... Perhaps it's just the otherworldly nature of the place...
Halfway through the ruins, Zeorg and Iris are nowhere to be found. The party's unease grows stronger.
The party spots familiar figures in the corridor. Iris and Zeorg are standing there...
When the falling light stops, a massive machine belching steam comes into view. Clearly, they've succeeded in activating it.
The fortress is filled with metal and machines. The party quickly realizes they don't belong...
It's difficult to notice when enemies approach with the noisy machinery. Sneak attacks can come at any time!
A face-off with Zeorg in the narrow hall. The time has come to settle just who is on the side of right.
The Hero has finally faced facts, but then alarms ring through the fortress.
Iris says she feels a massive power from this tower, like none before. The party must find out what it is.
It is dead silent inside the tower. Faint sunlight fills the desolate, empty hallways.
Iris won't say anything, but her face shows her fatigue. If only there was somewhere to rest...
They're almost there. Countless monsters are coming to mount the defense.
Beyond this door, everything may be revealed. Everyone feels uneasy, but they still reach for the door.
The journey has finally reached the Demon stronghold. It is time to seize the future and defeat Ragsherum.
Thunder fills the air, and lava bubbles up from cracks in the earth, as if they were escaping from hell.
The party follows the dim volcano trail. Suddenly, the low-hanging clouds are ripped by an attacking volcano bird!
Terrain, heat, monsters... The volcano hosts a triple threat. The slightest misstep could prove deadly.
Suddenly, the blazing hellscape resounds with a roar. The volcano's master descends blazing to the quiet earth.
A beautiful shrine of ice. Yet again, the party enters a region inimical to life.
A white-haired swordsman appears in the icy corridor. His sword flows like water as he attacks!
It's as if time has stopped in the shrine. And so, perhaps, have the hopes of the Hero.

q.n: The Flash of the Ice Spear
q.desc: The party reaches a wide hall. The master of the shrine lies in wait.
The exit from the shrine must be beyond this sanctuary hall. The party rushes forth, as if to outrun the cold.
Even without Roy, the party pushes through the trees, but their steps are slow, and words are few.
The party proceeds through the trees, fighting every step, but their movements lack spirit. Mira unleashes her rage...
The sound of motors is out of place in the deep forest. It appears machine troops are after the trespassers!
Whispers can be heard from within the forest. Could it be evil spirits living in the trees?
The whispers grow louder and closer. It appears the party is completely surrounded!
The party's talk seems to have had some effect. They set off through the corridor with new resolve.
Iris says she remembers these ruins. In search of her memories, the two start exploring.

q.n: The True Will of the Gods
q.desc: There is meaning in every structure, but the meaning of these ruins is beyond the ken of man.
In faint memories, it appears this ruin has some connection to Rayas, as well. Although this is his first visit...
In search of more memories, the two keep exploring. Before their eyes, their greatest friend reappears.
After searching the ruins, the party reaches the Black Gate. Beyond it lies Demon territory.
The party proceeds through the dark miasma, toward the castle. It appears someone is following them.
The party heads straight for the castle, avoiding Demon attacks. They have no time to stop.
The girl from the library makes a reappearance, but this time, something's different...
Grad and Nier stand in the way, murder in their eyes. The time has come to end this dark bond!
Now to defeat Ragsherum and stop the return of the Demon Lord. The party breaks into the castle, resolve in their hearts.
The castle interior seems filled with manifested darkness. The party proceeds through the stifling atmosphere.
The party revisits a place already destroyed by the Corps. Has Roy made it back to the Isliid Empire?
An unspeakable power emanates from beyond this ominous gate. The master of this castle lies ahead.
The battle for humanity's future has begun. Rayas must fight with all his body and soul and defeat Ragsherum.
The party passes the dimensional warp and reaches the Sealed Land. It is filled with infinite stillness.
The Sealed Land is being thrown into instability. A mistake could cost everyone their lives here...
The sense of time is becoming unclear. Even the flow of time is distorted here.
Iris guides the party through the Sealed Land. The time to settle things with Auge draws near.
Demon Lord Auge shows himself, clad in an aura of quiet death. This is the final battle.
Rayas and Iris have arrived at Barmint. Their journey brings back memories of a trip long ago...
Walking through the never-ending desert, their lively banter knows no end, much like the sand stretching before them.
The steep slopes and heat can't stop these two, but violent enemies also stand in their way.
As the hot desert wind burns their cheeks, Rayas and Iris think about their friend, Roy.
The two continue to trudge through the desert... Who watches them from the stormy plains?
The majestic scenery of Bamint welcomes them. After the burning desert, it is a respite.
At the bank of the quiet sunken temple, Rayas and Iris discuss trouble brewing in lands afar.
They bask in the wealth of knowledge at the temple. Unfortunately, there is no time to enjoy it.
Monsters quiently emerge from the quiet pond. Be careful to take one step at a time.
Someone awaits Rayas and Iris in the temple depths. Who are they, and what is their purpose?
A gentle summer breeze blows through the trodden path. Quite the opportunity to ask Melia some questions...
Rayas and Iris have a foreboding feeling after Melia tells them of a shocking truth...
Monsters appear by the riverbank alongside the path. Be very careful moving forward.
Melia reveals the complex situation of the world... What will be Mira's fate in this uncertain time?
The ancient Bamint path nears its end. A powerful foe awaits them.
The castle ruins stand in the far distance. Inside it awaits the person Melia told them about.
The sun sets and shines its last light on the wasteland. Don't let your guard down... Monsters rule the night!
As Bamint furiously seeks the glory of its past, this ruinous castle quietly shows its future.
The party heads to the Shattered City. It's a long path, but all journeys start somewhere.
Rayas and the others reach the heart of the castle ruins and find somebody unexpected awaiting them!
Under the shining red moon, Rayas and the others go onward looking for Mira in the Shattered City.
Along their path, the group sometimes gets to see an unexpected side of Celia.
The bloody moon casts the world bright red, making monsters more ferocious than ever.

q.n: Rise and Fall of an Empire
q.desc: There is a mysterious tradition in this ruinous city that was once filled with glory.
Celia seems curious about Rayas and Iris, since she does not usually have the chance to meet people like them.
Arriving at the underground ruins, the site's oddness is otherworldly... Is Mira really here?
It appears magic was practiced here long ago... Now it is teeming with monsters!
Celia speaks of her good memories with Mira. She seems nostalgic, but there is also a certain sadness in her eyes.
Monsters hide in the shadows of the ruins. Be careful not to disturb them.
The party finds Mira and wants answers, but first they will have to defeat the ancient relic standing before them.
Rayas and the others arrive at La Riiz, only to find difficulties facing them right away.
It seems that the Cult hired assassins. Keep an eye out for them.
Why is the Cult attacking Rayas and the others? It must be a long story.
Concentrate on passing through the burning city while keeping an eye out for assassins.

q.n: The Hidden Truth of La Riiz
q.desc: What truth are they hiding in La Riiz? Melia seems to know something...
Beyond the burnt city is a view completely unique to La Riiz.
Magic Stones can be found in the wetlands. Keep an eye on the path to find them.
Melia talks about Magic Stones but seems a little down...
Melia teases Rayas in good fun, but it's hard to shake the feeling that something is wrong.
Melia still seems a bit down, but on the other hand, how's Iris doing?
Rayas and the others reach the Lost Forest of La Riiz.
Created after an unsuccessful experiment, the forest is indeed very dangerous.
A little lost, the party moves foward little by little. Who awaits them?
The assassin appears in the Lost Forest, but Rayas is exhausted already...

q.n: At the End of the Lost Forest
q.desc: You're almost there! So close to the end, but trouble lies ahead...!
Beyond the forest, there is an abandoned mine of Magic Stones.
Still aware of the assassins, Rayas and the others proceed through the mine.
Moving through the mystical mine, everyone's worried about Melia...
Melia seems to be feeling better. There is light at the end of the tunnel!
No assassin attacks yet, but they may attack at any moment.
There's an anecdote about the training hall where Melia's headed...
A training hall for wizards and hideout for witches... The air is heavy here.
Melia has started to reveal her past. What did the Cult do to young Melia?
An intruder suddenly attacks! Hurry to the magic lab now!
The Cult's actions come to light through Melia's story, but she is interrupted...
The beast's ferocious claws are guided only by pure malice.
They reach the place where Melia spent her childhood. It's time to go further in.
Iris has a bad feeling about this place... Keep an eye out for danger!
There is a disturbing air to the place, but the party must go on. What is on Melia's mind?
One more step until the transfer device! Can Rayas and company get there safely?
The comrades Rayas fought with are now challenging him. Don't back down!
Rayas and the others are teleported to the Aerial City. Immediately, a problem occurs.
The temple is so large that no one knows where to go.
The party is wandering the temple cluelessly when somebody suddenly calls out to them.
The mysterious woman forces the crew to come with her. They don't know what's happening, but they follow her directions.
The mysterious woman directs them to their next location. Meanwhile, Melia is hurt...
Rayas follows the path that Norn mentioned. On the way, he thinks about his mission.
There are watery hallways full of monsters, but why?
Rayas arrives at a mystical place that he has never seen before, and he notices its beauty.
Fish are swimming in the sky. Is this a gift from La Riiz?
Rayas reaches the end of the underwater corridor and realizes something...
Once they get out of the corridors, they arrive at a forest garden. What awaits them there?
The party fights off the attacks from the assassin. Colorful flowers surround them.
There seems to be all sorts of delicious-looking fruits in this forest garden...
Plants grow despite the weather and the environment. Rayas and Iris admire their beauty.
The party progress through the forest garden. A plant tainted with magic blocks their way.
The tree seeps poison laden with its hatred for the world.
The party reaches a sunny hill, but Iris seems to be faring badly.
Iris is still feeling unwell, so Rayas carries her on his back. Their progress is slow.
Iris seems to have fallen asleep on Rayas' back.
They go through the path with sunlight coming through the trees. It is a brief respite.
Norn called this place a graveyard. The huge garden is lit up with peaceful sunlight.
Iris seems to feel better with Norn's help, but something seems to be wrong with her.
The waste treatment plant is full of monsters!
Rayas is interested in the wasteland, but Iris' heart is somewhere else...
There's an awkward air between Rayas and Iris at the spooky waste plant.
Things are still awkward between Rayas and Iris, and Rayas has had enough.

q.n: A Dreadful Scene at the Garden
q.desc: Suddenly an enormous sound roars throughout the city. What is going to happen to La Riiz?
There's nothing left of the beautiful garden... With tense feelings, the party moves forward.
Rayas and Iris felt the presence of a Demon. Will they fight?
It's not like Gormarey--only Rayas and Iris are here. They will have to stop the Demon themselves.
When the party reaches the middle of the garden, something unexpected happens...
Rayas and friends reach the great caverns under Isliid.  An unimaginable sight awaits them!
The heat of the Agrana Caves robs the group of their stamina.
What did Fen have his sights on when he sent Ru to La Riiz?
Where ravaging lava is formed. These searing caves are its birthplace.
The Demons seem to be moving faster than imagined. The group is thrown into worry.
A beautiful and mysterious lake awaits them after the searing heat.
The area around the lake is frigid. Be careful not to freeze!
This vast space which extends under Isliid seems to hide a grand mystery.
The lake is deeper than the eye can see. What is casting these shadows on the surface?
Iris shows interest in the Six Great Witches. What tales of them survive?
After the lake, the group finds a grand, mysterious hill.
This area is filled with light and greenery, almost as if they were above ground.
The noblewoman Celia comes to the rescue. What is the dream that drives her?
The group still has not found the Demons. Their unease grows even greater.
The group continues to climb the hill. Will they be able to catch the Demons?
The group reaches the Palace of Light. Is the secret of summoning hidden within?
Demons fill the palace. Don't let them have their way!
Norn explains things to Rayas and Iris. However, her explanation just raises more questions!
Norn continues to drop bombs of truth. Rayas is unable to find any calm.
Only the depths of the palace remain.  Who awaits the group there?
The group departs for the Temple of Darkness after a signal from Celia.
The shrine is enveloped in an unsettling aura. What hides in the dark and gloomy corridors?
How did the Gods make this dark-enshrouded shrine? No one knows...
Celia remains hidden. Rayas' heart is a storm of fears and anxiety.
After braving Nier's assault, the group discovers a familiar sight.

q.n: At the Realm of Gods Again

Use Support equipment to fill your Arts gauge and unleash your Arts!
Magic is weak against enemies with magic resistance. Hit them with physical attacks!
The longer a battle lasts, the worse off you'll be. Make your victory quick and decisive.
When you take massive damage, be sure to heal and regroup!
It's hard to damage enemies with high DEF. Critical hits ignore DEF to do damage!
Damage bosses using Physical or Magic Attack Equip Skills.
Damage increases during Break! Fire off your Arts and do massive damage!
Even if you lose you can try again, continuing where you last left off! Beat it with as few tries as possible!
Assemble 8 units to face a challenging foe! Match races and elements for buffs and win!
Test out new attacks and tactics against a Boss dummy!
The eggs with knowledge started a counter-attack! Don’t get swallowed into the silver crowd!
The birds with knowledge won’t stop! Face the silver birds and wipe them out!
Although she's just a cook, Sophie stood bravely against the monsters, embarrassing Rayas...
The forceful Sophie has revealed a shocking supply line for her ingredients...
Rayas is a humble adventurer... But this won't end with some teasing!
Rayas's carelessness spreads some mysterious mushroom spores...
Sophie takes up her frying pan to teach Rayas one last lesson!
Sophie's eye catches all. Can Rayas demonstrate real skill?
Sophie's tongue is hard to please. If the taste is off, her fry pan will guide you!
Sophie is the Master Chef of the Firecat's Den. Can Rayas gain her approval?
Loosen your belt and savor Sophie's signature smorgasbord!
She prepared this meal with heart and soul. Clean the plate before it gets cold!
Mira and Rayas have come to Famelle's beach to investigate "ghost" sightings...
With weather perfect for a swim, nothing unusual is appearing at the beach... But Mira is acting a little oddly...
Rayas wants more clues, but Mira's mood is worsening and she just won't talk.
There's no sign at all of any "ghostly" apparitions. And Mira seems a bit too relieved...
The beachcombing is fruitless. Instead of ghosts, Rayas spots a familiar figure.
On Ru's advice they head to the Ghost Ship, but Mira is clearly not happy...
Mira took fright and bolted after an unpleasant sound. Rayas needs to hurry and catch up as soon as possible!
Hurrying before it's too late, Rayas searches for Mira but can't find her.
Someone has appeared in front of Rayas... The closer he gets, the more obvious this isn't Mira.
"Mira" has attacked Rayas! But who is she, really?
Mira's face is an open book. What is it that she hates so much...?
To work on Mira's fears, the pair moves away from the Ghost Ship.
Rayas encourages Mira as they head to a cave in Famelle said to be haunted.
Arriving at the cave, Mira starts to explain why she's so scared.
Mira feels inferior next to her older sisters, and Rayas wants her to feel better.
Mira hasn't said a word since leaving the cave. She must have been terrified!
With no improvement in Mira's weakness, the two return. But Mira's knees are knocking...
Mira is as afraid as ever, but this time she's set on solving this mystery.
Rayas has no fear of ghosts, his adventurous heart is too strong!
The two confront the master of the Ghost Ship. Scared as she is, Mira won't back down.
Mira has decided to test Rayas' sword arm. It appears she's just passing the time...
"This time, we're settling this!" Mira says, facing down Rayas.
If you win the battle against the Lady, you'll gain her approval! But don't say you didn't ask for this...
Awoken Mira is here! Wage a splendid battle with the Third Lady!
Mira continues to fight although she won in numerous battles. Now it's time to challenge her!
All the strongest warriors are now here! It's your time to become a hero!
Receiving a report of mysterious monsters seen, Rayas comes to Demoneseal Tower "Medera" once again…
Rayas fights off Grad which was acting weird, and hurries back home. However, another known face stands in his way.
Grad stands in Rayas's way for the third time. He doesn't remember the conversation  they just had…
Rayas chases Grad and arrives at the Battle of Fort Goldoa. What awaits him is countless numbers of…
While fighting off hundreds of Grads, there seems to be one strong one!? Is he the real Grad or not?
Is there really the "real" Grad in this crowd? And yet, what is the true meaning of "real"?
Is the Grad in front of you real? He is the only one left for true.
Power is everything, the true source of pride. With a single blow, the mighty bestows despair.
He believes the quickest way to prove his might is complete and total slaughter.
The beastman of flames stands in the way at the entrance of the Dungeon.
Defeat the green fairy and blade wolf from the jungles and proceed to the next floor.
A deathly shadow stares back. You cannot move forward if this miasma is not defeated.
The deeper you go, the stronger your enemies become. Be careful of the swordswoman and her water-blade.
You need courage more than anything to proceed. Stay brave because the awakened ice giant will overpower you.
Once the swordswoman of light releases her powers of her treasured sword, no one can stop her attack.
The magical knight has revealed himself. What awaits you...hope or despair?
The sealed mechanized fortress in the other world has opened. Horrifying weapons protect their territory.
The dragon said to preside over all life has appeared. Do you have the resolve to overcome this desperate battle?
The guardian beast of the ice palace has flown into this world. The beast's cry casts the world into absolute coldness.
Winning this fight earns you the respect of Mira. It's a one-shot battle...not that you wanted to face her to begin.
Sophie is the master chef of the "Mountaincat Diner". Do your battle skills meet her tastes?
The silver hungry wolf has shown its true self. Is there anyone who can defeat this beast?
Can you really overcome this trial? The warrior's wild dance now starts…
Grad stands before you, but is this really him? All that's known is he was the only one to stay behind…
Burn away the ghost soldiers that keep arising and defeat the dark wizard.
Vicious power permeates this world. Is this nightmare eternal?! Fight with all your might!
Once a experimental subject, now an enemy against you! Stop the raging living weapon!
From the fire emerged the true One to rule all flames. The fire of truth will reduce all to ash.
A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Evade the deadly bolts to safety.igh
Why does the created life stand in the way? The girl who looks like Iris says nothing…
The crimson flames of the Blade Master from the Ancient War is in your way. Nobody can stop his flames of anger…
The Queen of the Dead leads her spider army against you. Any who fall before them will be consumed.
Evade the counterattack of Death dressed in black and shatter its soul together with the cloak.
Climb over fallen remains of the Defeated and stand against the hell-fire wreathed bird!
Vicious flames cover the whole place. Now you reached the burning prison of the Fire Spirits.
Your world approaches its end as the azure blade of the Silent Divine slashes through space and time.
Fend off the horde of rampaging dragons. Those who hesitate will never face their ruler.
The forest spirit trembles with indignant rage. Hack through the briars before they bury you!
When the deity's love overflows, the world will become drowned in everlasting darkness.
A severing edge juts from the void. The overlord's seal comes undone.
The Grand Prince of Sin smiles under his mask as he envisions the adventurers' utter ruin.
A wealth of murderous choices are presented: lashing, gouging, poisoning, or insanity.
A mysterious Armored Demon has appeared. Rayas heads to the Black Gate to find the truth.
Memories of his battle with Demons come back to his mind. Is such fierceness expected again?
While checking Gormarey, the party reunites an old friend. But why is she so exhausted?
Adventurers who break in for a little grave robbing are par for the course. No wonder Mira's fed up...
Iris and Rayas talk about their past adventures. It was full of danger, hardship, but also a bit of fun...
Searching doesn't turn up the Armored Demon. Perhaps it's already left?
The Hero has also come to investigate Gormarey. The mystery of the Armored Demon deepens...
The Armored Demon has not shown up, but with investigators from every nation here, it's clearly more than a rumor.
What is the Armored Demon after? Why is it attacking the adventurers and investigators?
The Armored Demon was Ragsherum after all! But... something is strange.
Melia brought up an unexpected possibility. What was that Ragsherum, really?
Leave Fen to check out the various possibilities, and go after Ragsherum!
The search for Ragsherum leads deeper into Gormarey. There's no turning back...
Something's wrong with Iris. Could there be traces of the Demon horde nearby?
If Fen's study is right, the Demon Armor's power is growing. It has to be stopped... fast!
Iris isn't looking well and makes a dire announcement. Their pace hurries as the Demon Armor draws near!
Just as Fen predicted, the Demon Armor is trying to take its master's place!
Ragsherum's ghost, driven out of the Demon Armor, draws near... Rush to the pool of magical power!
Hatred powerful enough to reanimate Ragsherum from the dead... Don't let this hatred continue!
Ragsherum's ghost has appeared at the pool of magic. No time to think, this fight will need every ounce of power!
A mysterious Armored Demon has appeared in Gormarey. Is it the one they already defeated?
Surpassing its master, and taking his place, this Demon Armor is gathering endless power. Seal it away!
Ragsherum's obsession with Rayas has transformed him into a ghost of vengeance! This time, he must be destroyed!
Rayas was all ready to escort Gilliam, but when monsters appear something odd happens...
Rayas came to help Gilliam gather materials, but...
While gathering materials, Rayas reveals his doubts to Gilliam.
Rayas has found one answer for the questions Gilliam raises...
He said he's talked too much, but Gilliam still has one more important story...
Gilliam has come to show Rayas the true worth of arms. Can he give a proper response?
Gilliam will some day complete this hero's blade. Can Rayas prove his worthiness?
The massive, tempered warhammer rests on equally firm shoulders. Feel his fire-forged spirit!
He knows both his gear and himself, smiling fearlessly at the challenger.

dungeons.n: Despair of the Ruthless Demon Armor

q.desc: Will this nightmare of vicious power and despair ever end?! Face Ragsherum with everything you got!
Lagan, the last place where Zeorg was. Are there any clues?
Rayas and Fen split up to investigate Lagan. Fight off the monsters and move forward!
The library should have been cleared by the Kingdom of Famelle. What happened to Lagan?
It's time to meet with Fen. Has he found any clues?
Rayas and Fen head to the area where the forbidden books are held. Will there finally find some clues?
Liese went toward the Demonseal Tower of Medela. Rayas and Iris go after her.
Iris feels something strange... Definitely something is happening...
They still can't find Liese. Trying not to worry too much, the two move forward.

q.n: A Little More until the Top
q.desc: They almost reached the last floor, but no trace of Liese. Will she be there?
Finally, Rayas and the others are at the top. They hurry, hoping that Liese is fine.
As Roy ordered, Rayas and Iris arrived at Cudre Del Ohne. What will be expecting them?
There seems to be nothing wrong. Rayas recalls his memories here.
Unlike their first visit here, now that they have time to spare, the party is enjoying the beautiful ruins... but don't forget to keep investigating.
There is no trace of what Roy said. Rayas is puzzled...
Iris is thinking hard and hasn't been talking... Rayas tries to cheer her up...
Now that Rayas and Iris are ready, their next goal is to go to the Realm of Gods!
What is the soul of the High God trying to do? Go find out about the Goddess' request!
Two souls in one body. Iris wants to grant the Goddess' wish. Help them fulfill their goal!

q.n: What Awaits in the Realm of Gods
q.desc: Whose soul is the one wandering the realm of Gods? Rayas and Iris go further in to find the answer.
The soul of the High God still doesn't show itself. Will it finally appear to them?
With a sudden flash, someone appears... It is a High God Rayas once defeated...
Marzex might help you... Believing those words, face him.
The light of Marzex becomes brighter. Will you be able to stand before him?
The Harbinger of Armageddon of the Heavens appears, born of Marzex' hate...
The Harbinger of Armageddon looks to consume and destroy the Merciful Marzex. Save the world from this peril!
Light and Dark. Mercy and Hate. Beware, for the judgment of the two Gods comes down on you--!
A raging menace interrupts a peaceful day... Stop it before someone gets hurt!
What does the unstoppable monster want?! Don't let it get out of hand!
The report says it has newfound powers! Is it trying to show off on stage?!
It's said to resemble a normal Goldola, making it weak to burns and crtical hits...
MEGA Goldola β reveals its true powers! Use 8 Legends to slay it once and for all!
Roy gives Rayas a job in Famelle. Will the rumored enemy show its face?
A dangerous presence lurks in Famelle... Rayas hurries in his search!
Every corner of the kingdom must be scoured. An adventurer's intuition and a little legwork will save the day!
Rayas joins Zeorg, who was prompted by a warning from the fabled sword Ryude Magus.
Ryude Magus has its own will and guides the pair. Not without questions, Rayas and Zeorg follow.
The sword responds differently than before. Zeorg has a bad feeling...
The Hero of Famelle is truly stout of heart. Rayas' is filled with admiration...
This blade was key in the heroic sagas of Zeorg's youth. Its brilliance consumes Rayas' eyes.
The Hero never says he's anything more than an old soldier, no matter the tales he's lived to tell. It's just how Zeorg is...
Zeorg, holder of the fabled blade, speaks of the threat they approach. The time draws near!
Fen is also pursuing the Demon Dragon the sword warned about. He splits up from Rayas and Zeorg to find it.

q.n: The Demon Dragon and the Hero
q.desc: What connection does the Dragon have with Zeorg? Are these legends of yore hiding something?
Is Famelle's great secret hidden in Zeorg's sagas? And what of the truth of the Demon Dragon?
Zeorg is in no position to speak the truth, but Rayas' faith in the Legend never wavers.
Zeorg's heroism reveal the true terror of the Dragon. It must be stopped before it's too late!
The party reaches Silkira, where the Dragon has taken refuge. The end is near... Stay sharp!
The party prepares for the final showdown with the Dragon. Can Rayas defeat the Demon Dragon of the Legend?
The Demon Dragon is coming for Ryude Magus. Can it be stopped?
As they approach the top, Ryude Magus grows anxious. The end is nigh!
The Demon Dragon awaits them at the top of Silkira. It will take all their strength to defeat it!
Zeorg decides to test out Rayas' progress with a little swordplay.
"I want to be stronger than anyone..." Rayas gives his all in a duel with Zeorg!
Your eyes flame with ambition as you face Zeorg! Show the Hero your true strength!
A giant mutant Dakyuon appears in front of you! As you get closer, you realize it's not going to be easy...
The Dakyuon devours everything in its path. you cannot leave it alone!
The Dakyuon's rampage grows out of control. Can you handle the situation?!
The giant Dakyuon attack continues! Don't hesitate to counter-attack!
A letter from Ru says that Fen's in danger! Hurry and head toward him!
Dara Desert is full of monsters. Don't let your guard down!
The letter only says "Fen is in Danger". What exactly happened to him?

q.n: In the Middle of the Desert
q.desc: The heat and monsters are getting to you. But you can't stop now!
You're almost there. Hurry through Coroc Road!

q.n: The Place Written in the Letter
q.desc: Rayas and Iris arrived to the specified place, but there seems to be no one around...
Countless monsters are attacking Rayas and the others. Is this what led Fen into danger?
Rayas and the others keep fighting against the monsters. But they don't seem to stop.
Coroc Road is full of monsters, even too many. What is happening?
Rayas is still fighting against the monsters. There seems to be even stronger ones coming.
Going red, Fen rushes out of sight. Rayas and the others go after him.
The party is now going through the wetlands. Iris seems to be curious about Fen's past.

q.n: Struggling in Thought and On Foot
q.desc: Rayas wonders about how Fen and Ru met in the first place...

q.n: The Past of Fen and Ru
q.desc: While the party is going after Fen, Iris keeps asking Ru about their past...
Rayas and Iris are back on track after listening to Ru's story. Their goal is so close!
Rayas and the others are now where Fen should be. But something happens out of the blue.
Ru disappearing? Leaving apologies, and then? A bunch of monsters... What is happening!?
Fen still cannot be found... You must bear against the attacks of monsters.
Still fighting against monsters, the situation that strikes Rayas and the others is highly unexpected.
Fen suddenly attacks Rayas. You need to find out why!
The strategist points his sword to Rayas: "My skills may be a bit dull, but be my guest".
"You cheeky guy. Suck it up!" Fen becomes more ferocious.
"From now is our true battle." The smile disappeares from the strategist's face.
昔と今。変わりゆく心境に戸惑うフェン。 軍師は気付く。その力は何の為のものなのか。
「生きて帰れたら褒めてやろう。」 その一言は確実な死の未来を予見させた。
Limited attempts!  Get materials to enhance and evolve your Units and Equipment!
Who is it that forbids entry to this forest? It is said that this forest has existed since the world was born.
The Watcher standing quiet guard, has crossed the time's barrier to guard the Ancient Forest and its master.
What has this warrior transcended time itself to protect? See the answer yourself!
Who exactly is this client waiting for Rayas on the Plains of Isliid?
The client was Nier?!  Lost in confusion, Rayas revisits Gormarey.
"I want to stop Nier's rebirth..." The clone says, her eyes filled with sadness.
Rayas, sensing that the clone is sincere and determined, promises to fulfill her job request.
The clone seems happy telling Rayas about the future. The abominable device is just ahead!
Another clone of Nier lurks in the fortress, guarding the equipment. Lay her pitiful soul to rest.
Having tasted power, the clone has grown arrogant. Stop her rampage!
She’s surpassed the original! The clone smiles haughtily as she unleashes her true power!
The true monster appears to devour the forged shell. Her venom brings death to all it touches.

dungeons.n: The Blade Is Thick As Blood

q.desc: Ganan orders Rayas and Iris to follow Est to Agrana Volcano.
When it comes to Est, even tough old Ganan can't hide his fatherly side. It'd be nice to help him calm down, but...
Est, the beautiful receptionist, is quite popular at the Arena. Maybe Ganan's right to be worried...
Neither Rayas nor Iris has seen Ganan's wife before... What is she like?
It looks like Est has thinned out the monsters around here... She certainly takes after her father!
What is Est up to all alone out here? She's clearly had more than enough training...
Iris is intent on hearing more about Est, but Rayas isn't sure how to answer...
Est is leaving a clear trail through the cavern. She's headed deep inside...
Only someone with a very good reason would come all this way. So what is Est's?
A colossus stands before Est! She's in danger alone... Back her up!
Est heads for Demonseal Tower Medela, with its rumored Demon ghost. Ganan joins the fight! It's not over yet!
The friends follow Est's trail. Hurry to catch up before the weather erases all trace!
It looks like Est is taking a shortcut to Medela. But this path is full of danger!
Est's footprints are growing ever fresher. She must be near!
It looks like the reason for Est setting out has to do with her mother. But catching her comes first!
Rayas thinks back on the constant fighting between Ganan and Est. This probably won't go well...
A mysterious woman in a hat waits at Medela. Who is this woman who seems to know Est...?
A feeling just like that time at Gormarey... Something very dangerous is here!
With this powerful aura, Est is in huge danger on her own. She must be found soon!
Est's breath is taken away by the approaching aura. But she resolves to stay strong and stand her ground.
Est is obsessed with greater and greater strength. Now she wants to challenge Rayas!
Rayas has dealt with Demons before, he must have the strength! Or so Est thinks...
Whether the Demon is real or fake, only one thing is clear. The time for battle is at hand!
Ancient androids suddenly attack you. Fight with all your hidden power!
The rampage of the past is revives in the present. Can you survive these overwhelming attacks?
The androids unleash their full power. The legend rips away the veil!
Victory means not survival but annihilation. Full-power cannons perforate the sky, even at risk of self-destruction.
Ru goes to town with Rolly, while Rayas leaves for his regular patrol.
Gentle sunlight falls over the world. The plains seem to be the same as ever.
While Rayas is on patrol, Ru and Rolly make a strange discovery.
The plains seem the same as ever, but Rayas can't shake the feeling that something is wrong.
Something strange is happening in the plains. Rayas discovers the cause.
Fen joins Rayas. Could Rolly and Ru be here?
The lava cave roils with blazing heat. Save your energy!
The beasts living in the cave are acting oddly. It appears something is afoot...
The disturbance in the lava cave is making Rayas nervous. Are Rolly and Ru safe?
Rolly and Ru are safe from the plants, but things can't be left like this...
A rare plant bares its fangs at Rayas. Be ready for anything!
Swarms of mysterious plants are on the attack. Stop them before they spread!
The boss of the monster plants finally shows itself. Prepare to face this incredible powerhouse!
Reigrad is in an Autumn festival mood. But Ganan has news of a strange Demon appearance!

q.n: One who Stands before the Demon
q.desc: The Demon they call Jack-O-Sherum has appeared again. It's a race to defeat it!
Iris says she has an idea to get rid of Jack-O-Sherum. And who is this mysterious swordsman?
The Spirit World is closest in this season. And wandering spirits find their way here...
The wandering spirits appear without cease. There is only one choice... to fight.
Jack-O-Sherum has unleashed all his power. Despair spreads before his awesome might!
The colorful gourds cackle in unison. Soon, the world will be swallowed by disaster.
Spooky light glows in the eye socket of the pumpkin. Don't be tricked by the sweet smell!
A swordsman sworn to the Higher Gods appears. He assaults Rayas with cold murder in his eyes!
The azure swordsman wields a mighty blade and impenetrable shield. You must penetrate his defenses to find victory!
For the Higher Gods... The swordsman's will surpasses his own limits, to discover new strength!
He changes the battlefield into a blue orchard. Each blade stroke carries the weight of his devotion.
It is not death he fears but dishonor. Therefore, he plunges faster and deeper into battle.
The world of Raktehelm is threatened like never before when Godzilla, the colossal Kaiju, attacks.
Each attempt to stop Godzilla only hastens his evolution. Even as despair sets in, everyone does their part to keep hope alive.
The ruler of ruin, Godzilla, wields fathomless power. The forces of Raktehelm gather for one last, desperate strike.
Godzilla rises once more from the forgotten depths. However, a new dragon-like monster also joins the fray.
As Godzilla and King Ghidorah do battle, all of Raktehelm can only watch and pray that their own ends will be spared.
The terrifying legend has become reality.... Stand your ground and defend Raktehelm!
The horror that threatens all has awoken... Fight its flames that will scorch all in its path!

dungeons.n: The Twin Knights of the Morning Star

q.n: Twin Knights of the Morning Star
q.desc: The legendary Twin Knights of the Morning Star stand right there! But they don't seem to notice Rayas...
The Twin Knights of the Morning Star are trying to cross the Magic Stone Marsh Ga Vaar. Where are they going?
The Knights survived the Ancient War and then traveled around the world.

q.n: A World without Gods and Demons
q.desc: Rayas, who knows the true history, reconsiders his point of view in light of Regulus' doubts.
Rayas' pursuit of the heroes leads him to a place he'd never imagined.
Everyone knows the story of the Knights from books. But Rayas wants to find out what happened next.

q.n: The Curse of the God Eater
q.desc: Regulus made a fatal error when facing the God Eater, but no one seems to have noticed...

q.n: The Twin Knights of Light and Dark
q.desc: They may be called Twin Knights, but they are truly opposites...
Unaware of the God Eater's curse, Regulus falls deeper into envy towards Feena.

q.n: The Last of the Twin Knights
q.desc: Rayas witnesses the final unknown story about the two Knights. Their sad finale comes to light.

drops: Sealed Tome "Truth of the Morning Star"
q.desc: Defend yourself from this man called the outcast of the Raven's Aegis.

drops: Sealed Tome "Truth of the Morning Star"
q.desc: Can you stop the blazing attacks of the Knight of Light, who once ascended to the ranks of the Gods?

drops: Sealed Tome "Truth of the Morning Star"
q.desc: These opposing poles stand together... Can you go beyond the legends standing in your path?
Rayas doesn't feel like tailing Melia. He starts moving with Roy's words in his mind.
No clues so far about Melia. They don't call her the "Blue-eyed Black Fox" for nothing.
Rayas has found Melia. He follows her until Gormarey, where they once fought together...
Rayas lost sight of Melia. She shouldn't be far. Let's look around.
Melia is talking to Nier, the demon they once defeated. What is going on...?
Melia is serious about this battle. Rayas asks himself if he is ready for this.

q.n: The Black Fox at a Loss
q.desc: Rayas remembers Melia's attitude. She definitely wasn't herself, what happened to her?
Rayas needs to clear Melia's suspicion. That's because he believes in her.
Although Rayas lost track of Melia, he finds her once again, but...
Melia forces Rayas to come after her. Who awaits them...? Rayas's belief shows the truth.
Melia, intelligence officer and vice-commander of the 3rd Magus Division of La Riiz. Can you fight against her powerful attacks?
You've never seen Melia in such facial expressions. Can you go beyond her powers as a spy?
Melia chants the secret precepts of La Riiz. Is it possible to win against her with all her powers released?
1st Anniversary Limited Daily Quest! Challenge every day and get awesome rewards!
A Giant has suddenly appeared and is pillaging the people. Rayas heads to the snowfield to stop the atrocity.
For some reason the Giant is dressed as Santa. No one knows why, but the Giant must be stopped.
The Giant continues to threaten the people. Rayas must stop this, especially for Iris.
They pick up their swords and hold tight their small yet unyielding beliefs.
Rayas has developed a friendship with the Giant. So they decide to have a little bout to see who's stronger.
Although it's a friendly bout, it's still serious business. Give it your all to show respect for the opponent.
Rayas has set a fire in the Giant's heart. Now the Giant shows it's true brutal nature towards Rayas.
Crunchyroll-Hime challenges you! Fight GS legends & Hime for rewards!
Ruins are appearing in various places. It seems there is special divine protection...
Only those who belong to flames can enter. There seems to be paintings on the walls...
You can hear roaring sounds from where you are heading to. You must brace yourself!
It's getting hotter and hotter the more you go in... Wipe off your sweat and move forward!
You can hear roaring sounds from where you are heading to. You must brace yourself!
Suddenly, silence surrounds you. Even flames are silent... The guardian has shown itself…
Roars reverberate throughout the Hellfire Ruins. Their source, a Dragon of Ice, appears before the adventurers.
Go through the flames, avoiding the Frozen Overlord, beyond the haze
At the end of the path through the burning ruins. A mysterious bird attacks, trying to drown out the flames with a blizzard.
At the presumed endpoint, there was one last obstacle standing among the flames, its feet tangled in tough ivy.
At the end of the scorching ruins stands a giant wrapped in a biting chill. Like an unstoppable glacier, he forbids all intruders.
Beyond the molten lava awaits a spirit of frost. A silvery chill numbs even the intense blaze.
An artificial creature defiles the sacred flames. With ice-blue claws, it mercilessly slaughters prey.
A phantasmal dragon settles among the blaze, its own dark fires stifling all light.
The crazed scorpion crawls among the ruins, roaring flames and deadly needle swaying.
Acidic rain falls over the inferno, bringing not nourishment but ruin.
A great commander manifests in the red. Wielding her subordinate's might, she dyes the flames black.
Ruins are appearing in various places. It seems there is special divine protection…
Without the protection of water, no one can enter. The beautiful insides somewhat make you uncomfortable…
Am I seeing a mirage? The scenery is so beautiful to think so.
The scenery does not change a bit no matter how long you walk. Is this really the correct way?
Suddenly a flash of sword light slashes the air. There is no time to be flustered!
You've fought off the countless enemies. There the guardian is, as if it had been waiting for you.
The adventurer proceed through the ruins, his ears battered by roars. And suddenly, a Dragon of Life appears from the earth.
Defeat the Verdant Dragon and head deeper into the ruins. The shadow of a man standing in the spray of water has twin swords in his hands.
The far end, led by the mysterious water-covered ruins.The evil bird manipulates the Thunderbolt to make the water surface surge.
After driving away the evil bird, the ruins continued. Beyond, a fiery deity waited, its anger generating endless steam.
A storm-brewing beast tears through the mists. Its prey has no chance of escape once in sight.
A hideous creature roars from deep within the mists. End its miserable existence!
Twin roars echo throughout the frozen temple. Its razor-sharp tail rips through flesh like air.
A dazzling beast appears from the waterfall. Its resounding roar brings death to mind.
The breath of the burning roc melts adventurers and ruins alike.
The silent ruins are overwhelmed by ivy's superior life force.
A great commander manifests in the blue. Wielding her subordinate's might, she illuminates the placid surface.
Ruins are appearing in various places. It seems there is special divine protection…
Only the ones who life with nature can enter this ruin. Be aware of the enemies in the shadows of evergreen.
It seems there are plants that you don't normally see. Be careful not to touch them…
You've got used to moving forward  through the green. So far there's nothing noteworthy…
With a cry so large it rips the air, the Emerald Bird flies in your way! In order to move on, you must defeat it.

rew: Fire Relic "Bible of the Flaming Knight"
q.desc: Strangely, hot wind blows against you. The guardian quietly stands in front of you.

rew: Fire Relic "Sword of the Flaming Knight"
q.desc: The lushly overgrown ruins are suddenly engulfed in flames. The flames of the divine Fire Dragon will burn all!
Having defeated the Inferno Dragon, further into the forest. A shadowy figure peers at you with inferno blazes in their eyes.
The thickly wooded ruins come to an abrupt end. A giant bird flies in to destroy the trees with scorching heat.
The settling blazes opened a new path. A fortress of ice, disturbed by the intruders, opened its eyes.
The calm of the forest is interrupted by a wild inferno. Even towering trees are consumed by the spirit's searing flames.
A towering inferno looms over the wooded expanse, threatening to raze all with blazing fists.
When the fox spirit appears, the moon will dim and the verdant temple will glow with her flames.
A low howl emerges from the dark forest as a baneful odor crushes the bravest souls.
The silent flash of her divine swords instantly rends all life in the overgrowth.
The canopy is wrapped in a fierce blaze that consumes existence.
A great commander manifests in the green. Wielding her subordinate's might, she pollutes the forest with despair.

dungeons.n: The Five Freedom Fighters The Dawn of Raktehelm

q.desc: Freed has doubts about the end of the Ancient War that once threw the world into chaos.
Freed resolves to set out on a trip to investigate the end of the war after gaining new intel from Rishley.
Now that Freed has decided to set out on his journey for truth, he asks a friend for help.
The journey starts with the researcher Louvet and the shady Onfuan, former intelligence operative of La Riiz.
A legendary beast appears so soon after the journey begins! What is it after?
Sonije, the girl the party saved from the monster, forces her way into the group.
The five travelers enjoy a pleasant journey. However, these five will eventually be known as the Five Freedom Fighters.
The travelers head toward Gormarey. What lies in the fortress sealed away by the Five Great Nations?
As the history they've been taught starts to fall apart, the travelers move to investigate the depths of Gormarey.
The truth of the end of the Ancient War awaits them in the depths of the fortress.
A woman who has guarded this orphanage for a very long time now unleashes her power. Who is she, really?
The lovely princess reveals her hidden expression of a vicious, axe-wielding warrior.
The axe-wielding princess and the heavy-weapon android give chase. You must fight back with all your might!
While Celia stays in Bamint, Rayas and the others head to the Magus Empire of La Riiz.
The party moves through La Riiz. Rayas seems to be worried about Celia.
While Celia is busy investigating about the conspiracy, Rayas asks Melia a question.
There seems to be something fishy going on between Bamint and La Riiz...
Although being attacked, Rayas and the others can't stop now. On the other hand, Celia heads to the hideout of the radicals.
There is a connection between La Riiz and the Demons. Rayas doesn't know yet...
Celia understood that she was a pawn in the Demons plans, but she doesn't lose her temper.
Rayas and the others are headed toward the center of La Riiz. At the same time, Celia receives an urgent message.
From the outset of La Riiz and Bamint, riot spreads across the world.
Celia has finally tracked down the radicals. Now she must end this battle.
The first Princess of Bamint, Celia will be teaching sword skills to Rayas.
It is time for the Princess of a high noble family to show her real powers. Do not hesitate and challenge her.

dungeons.n: The Five Freedom Fighters Last Wishes Passed to the Future

q.desc: After getting caught up in the shock from the Five Freedom Fighters' fight at Gormarey, he awakens in an unfamiliar forest.
Grohl has been watching Sonije and her family. His blade draws near...
Sonije mulls over inviting Onfuan to their abode after she is deceived by the disguised Grohl.
Grohl pursues Sonije as she does just what he set her up to do. What will she do next...?
Onfuan tries to show Sonije how she's been deceived, but battle seems inevitable.
As Sonije and Onfuan face off, Louvet gets a bad feeling...
Grohl returns to the battlefield to find only Onfuan's corpse and Sonije's severed arm.
Grohl moves on the last two of the Five Freedom Fighters, now unprotected by their barrier.
At the same time, a shocking event leads to the end of Rishley and Freed's quiet life in hiding.
Freed is bewildered by Rishley's last words. That face beneath the mask, that voice... Could it be?
Former intelligence operative Onfuan's mastery of barrier magic protected the Five Freedom Fighters. Can you take him?
Dragon scholar Louvet has pierced the veil covering the truth of history. Stand against his brilliant tactics!
The Five Freedom Fighters tried to change history. Surpass their power and inherit their final wish!
Rayas doubts the mysterious lady claiming to know of Marzex's sudden return.
Though Riana says she knows Ganan, there is an unusual age gap between them.
She turns out to be a descendant of the Sword Master, and her words greatly confuse Rayas.
Cursed with perennial youth, Riana's body remains in top condition...at a price.
What does Marzex have to do with this dark energy?
Riana spares no detail in telling Rayas of her most romantic encounter.
In yet another tale, Riana shares how family led her to an eye-opening realization.
Following in her mother's footsteps, Est makes Riana proud.
As Est recognizes her feelings towards her parents, her mother beams as if connected by the heart.
Rayas & Riana climb up Demonseal Tower Medera. What secrets does this miasma hold?
Can you take on this fencing fiend?!
Try to hold out against the warrior of legendary lineage!
Time to surpass the miasma-absorbing swordswoman!
Ruins are appearing in various places. It seems there is special divine protection…
Only those celebrated by light can enter. The shining ruins will catch your breath.
So silent, it is like the ruins are completely forgotten. Be careful and move forward.
Even one step feels so loud. The cold light makes you lonely.
Even light feels so heavy. Will you be able to conquer whatever waits ahead?
Suddenly darkness fills the area. The guardian shining so bright stands in your way!
A shadow stands in the way of the adventurer. From the dark, the Hadean Dragon shows itself.
Having laid the Hadean Dragon to rest, you climb its corpse and head forth. A figure lies in wait with a greatsword in hand, ready to do battle.
At the end of a long path through the light-flooded ruins. A devil's armor casts a shadow over the destination.
When the cursed armor shatters, another path is formed. A powerful new enemy then attacks, leaving no time for shock.
Princess of insects emerges from the pouring light. The spearhead glints ominously as she points it at you.
Silvery wings cast a shadow against the white light. With a great roar, the adventurers shiver with fear.
A shadow of madness wavers in the radiance. Light-rending claws assault all who approach.
A divine blaze overpowers the ruins' gleam. That torrent of heat engulfs the brave souls.
An ominous gloom pervades these sacred grounds. Deep-rooted malice clings around those who enter.
Inside the complete void of the Spirit, everything becomes nothing.
A great commander manifests in the light. Her absolute justice holds sway over the holy domain.
Ruins are appearing in various places. It seems there is special divine protection...
Only those with shadows can enter. Don't let the darkness get you...
It feels depressing inside. Don't lose yourself...
Not only the monsters but the dark pressure makes you want to escape...
Suddenly a huge roar fills the area. The Demonic Dragon bares its fangs.
The dragon is gone and light shines. The guardian full of darkness is in your way!
A flash lightened up the darkness in this pitch-dark ruin. Now the Radiant Dragon has arrived to give judgement to the adventurer.
Overcoming the Radiant Dragon, you press forth. The light envelops a figure standing in prayer.
At the deepest end of the ruins shrouded in darkness. Benevolent Annihilator's blinding flash rips through the gloom.
A heavenly presence protects this passage. At the end, a Spirit of light awaits with an eerie smile.
An agent of corrosion emerges from the gloom. Its cursed roar echoes through the dusty halls.
A god of death sneers in the lightless ruins. Avoid the fatal edge of its scythe and defeat it!
When the master of the arcane awakens, uncanny visions will illuminate the darkness.
Jade lightning echoes from the black depths, ready to cast judgment upon the foolish intruders.
Time slows to a halt then reverses direction as a defiant deity wields his powers with impunity.
A heavy, dull sound paralyzes the adventurers. Her spear has just pierced an ally's skull.
A great commander manifests in the darkness. His surging willpower clears away the haze.
Rayas has been given a truly odd job by Fen. What is he after?
Rayas is struggling with this unusual job of pretending to be an assassin.
Rayas continues his survey of the target areas in a route that stretches across Gramenia.
Rayas is enjoying his trip since the pass he received gives him unrestricted access to Gramenia.
There are more threats against the president than just assassins. Rayas hurries toward his objective.
Dangerous monsters could appear at any moment. Rayas' exhausting search continues.
The survey areas are filled with peril. Why is the president even taking this tour?
Fen and Kane are Rayas' clients for this job, but what are the two really after?
The survey is nearing its end, but not before Rayas senses a terrible presence.
The reports never mentioned this beast! This is the true threat to the president's tour!
Rayas has been challenged to a match by a man calling himself an old friend of Fen's. How strong is he?
Face the might that protects an entire nation!
Kane is president of the Gramenia Republic. See just how much power the leader of this nation bears!
A Dragon general whose name echoes through history arrive, surrounded in solemnity. Can you answer his fearful blade?
An unparalleled general of the Dragons attacks. Evade his all destroying blade and strike back!
A Dragon General who seeks an end to Humanity itself appears. Face him with all your resolve to preserve a future for all!
A monster on the loose and girls in pursuit?! Rayas has to chase them to find out what's going on!
Strange girls appear as Rayas and Mira travel through the forest. Who could they be?
Ryuko and the others have joined Rayas, and now must find the beast to discover the truth!
It appears the monster wasn't driven by Life Fibers... But then what is the monster standing before them?!
This monster is controlled by something similar to Life Fibers... But now, the starved monster bares its fangs!
Mutation has given rise to bizarre creatures... They must defeat the outsider controlling the monsters!
The monsters are controlling the doppelgangers! But beware... their hidden strength is nothing to laugh at.
Crossover Gem has a chance to drop from this challenging five-times-daily quest!
Better chance to get Crossover Equips! Five times per day only "Bonus Quest".
More rewards for more DMG! Take along KILL la KILL Crossover units for an edge!
Test your might against Satsuki! Come out on top and get Crossover Tickets!
Test your might against Uzu! Come out on top and get Crossover Tickets!
Rayas awakens in an unfamiliar forest. He finds a lone girl training intently with a bow.
The Crimson Stars are headed towards the kingdom for a performance. It's about time to set up camp.
The Crimson Stars have reached their destinaiton. The city is bustling in preparation for the once-in-a-decade festival!
Mamori is looking for a place to set up their stage, but she's having some trouble.
Diaz and Pientz are looking for a place to set up camp, but for some reason, they seem to be very intent about the location...
The Crimson Stars put on their first performance. There's still a few days until the festival, but the seats are full and everyone is abuzz.
It is the morning after the mysterious attack, and Mamori has gone to the nearby woods to calm her nerves.
The Crimson Stars put their performance on hold after the attack and try to figure out what's going on.
The night before the kingdom's great festival, Mamori sits alone, staring up at the sky in disappointment.
Mamori is stunned by the true strength of her allies as they face the assassins' attack.
Can you evade the bullets of this master assassin, stained with the blood of countless targets?
This master assassin will take any contract if the price is right. Don't let your guard down for an instant, lest it cost you your life.
The legendary assassin shows his pride. It will take all your skill to survive this battle!
A pierrot clad in flame appears. What does this smiling man want?
The beasts called out by the pierrot surround you. Fight your way free!
The unending herd of beasts goes into a frenzy. Muster all your strength for this life and death battle!
Mamori has been sent away by Diaz and Pientz, and now wanders the woods, dazed and alone.
Mamori has mimicked tales of the heroes her whole life.  Now, what does she have to defend?
The Crimson Stars set about fulfilling their true goals now that Mamori has left them.
The assassins are still after Diaz and Pientz.  Are their plans so easily shattered?
Diaz lied. It was all for Mamori, who is destined to save the world...
This pair still seeks to kill the Crimson Stars.  Both are among the best at what they do, but they're not the best match.
Sly has alerted the Royal Army. It doesn't look like the two can fight through...
The two seek vengeance for the pain of their childhoods. And the Crimson Stars are on the warpath now.
It is the morning before the king reveals himself to his people in a once-in-a-decade ceremony. And someone is moving in the quiet streets.
Diaz and Pientz have placed their lives on the line to get their revenge. What will come of it? What future have they found?
Voghan has sculpted his body to kill. Shatter his blood-red blade!
Voghan says his greatest reward is the thrill of the kill.  Can you resist his warped delights?
The beast laughs as it shreds flesh and spills blood. Can you cut it down?
Tallis, a hero who served to save her nation... And a powerful swordswoman known as the Ogre Slayer.
Tallis' master the King desires a permanent peace between all the races and devotes himself to tireless diplomacy.
The representative of all the nations besides the Giants and Dragons agreed to a meeting. What shall it bring about?
The representatives are clearly suspicious of each other. Tallis is careful as she pushes forward with the talks.
Tensions are easing as the members start to get a sense of each other. The real talk begins in earnest.
Jill and the others of the Human host country offer a grand feast, and everyone enjoys the pleasant atmosphere...
The meal was cursed. Lozze and Vicious turn their doubting eyes on Tallis.
Tallis insists on her innocence and fervent wish for peace, but Lozze refuses to listen.
Tallis' defense never falters. But Lozze and Vicious keep stepping up their attacks.
Tallis and Pheles refuse to strike hard and resort to persuasion, all in service to their ideals.
Your duel with Tallis, mistress of the Radiant Ittoryu school and Royal Army Fencing Instructor, begins!
