Can you dodge the wild attacks of the raging PrinceLozze as he gives in to his instincts?
Can you withstand the radiant blade of the salvation of her country, the Ogre Slayer herself?
A Machine warrior born to battle stands in your way. What do her eyes see?
Unlike before, she now has her own reasons to fight. But what are they?
This weapon that knowns only battle has a question. What is a peaceful world? Can you show her the answer?
Will this Six Nation Summit called for peace end in bloodshed?
Tallis' words have moved Lozze' heart. But Vicious fights on without cease.
Vicious shows no sign of relenting against her three opponents. Tallis and the other can simply endure.
Vicious' assault rains down upon the other three. Why does she fight so?
The Demons have been behind this fight all along. But Tallis, the Savior of the Nation, will never lower her blade.
Even greater attacks land on Tallis, to make mockery of her plans. The chaotic battle grows more frantic.
Mixe falls to Vicious' surprise attack. The Machine is after Talils' life.
Vicious shows her hatred of Tallis for all to see, and steps up her attack again.
Hatred is overtaking the cool-headed Machine. Amidst her rampage, Vicious speaks a shocking name.
Tallis stands against Vicious' rage, twisted will, and assault. All for a distant future...
A glittering smile plays on the beautiful girl's face as she whispers. Resist the spine-chilling truth behind the smile!
The real beast hiding behind her gentle demeanor runs wild. Expose the truth behind the Ancient War!
This she-beast lies at the heart of all the doubts about the Ancient War. Expose her to the light!
The tower of tribulations new adventurers face. Show the entrance guards you're worthy!
Heavily-armored block your way to the next floor. You must defeat him to go forward.
A giant thrashes the entire floor. Take down this menace before this hulk destroys the tower!
A Pirate King parched for battle strikes! Can you prove yourself to this outrageous warrior?
A dark dragon fuming with fury awaits a new hero... If fear is what you feel, turn back now.
A soldier who harnesses the power of dragons stops your way. Resist his flames and go forth.
A Spirit Archer tests your skills with her arrows. Do not hold back and make your mark!
The path ahead is still long, and you there's no time to be stopped by a shape-shifting soldier!
There is no way to stop to escape her demon scythe, short of ending her life...
There is no way to avoid crossing blades with this prideful Beast Saint. Face him down.
A legendary Dragon God tests your courage. Do not flinch from its burning breath and defeat it.
The angry winged-dragon tests how quickly you fight and think on your feet. Outsmart it to survive!
The cursed bird of storms test your agility! Weave between the lightning bolts and stop its rein!
The Frozen Dragon tests your burning desire to become a true adventurer! Show the fire inside!
The adventurer's journey never ends... Not even against a giant bird spewing down hellfire.
Alvina stands before her mother's grave to say farewell... What is she intending to put an end to?
Alvina sets out on a journey to deliver her mother's words. Who will she find at the end of the road?
Alvina searches for a place to stay in the bustling town, filled with travelers.
Alvina and Lucia sign on as the town's guards. Can they defend the border of the Gods Empire?
Alvina and Lucia grow closer as they keep the town safe.
Riffili, embarrassed by her run-in with Alvina and Lucia, calls on her Demon friend for help.
The Demon Army presses on, but Alvina and Lucia refuse to give any ground.
Alvina pushes Corsair against a wall, but something is happening inside of her...
Corsair takes Alvina's relentless attacks. Alvina makes no attempt to hide her murderous rage.
Alvina now defends Corsair, while Corsair watches her back. The bonds of sisterhood run deep.
Alvina freezes all her opponents in ice. Can you resist her vicious spear?
Can you overcome the frigid spear blows that bested Corsair of the Three Blade Masters?
Will the Frost Spear that mastered the powers of darkness protect Rayas until the end?
Nogia, bearer of the Sacred Sword, calmly prepares himself. Could it be time to draw his blade?
Nogia quietly draws his sword. What power will this sword, which slashes that which can't be slashed, show us?
Nogia, bearer of the sacred blade's destiny, appears. Follow the path of his destiny with the sacred blade on his back.
Palamicia receives orders to subdue a mysterious High Demon that is scorching the lands of Raktehelm.
Palamicia goes to face Ifrit, hoping that this opponent is truly mighty...
Palamicia faces Ifrit, who is scorching the land clean. What kind of battle awaits her?
Saved in the nick of time by a mysterious man, Palamicia has no choice but to withdraw.
The man who saved Palamicia tells his story, and his purpose in the pursuit of Ifrit.
The two prepare to go in search of Ifrit for a new match. Will they find his trail?
Palamicia's pace grows forceful as she comes to believe what she's heard about Ifrit's true face.
Palamicia begins looking for a certain man as she steps foot on the scorched earth left by Ifrit.
Palamicia and Ifrit are finally facing each other again. What feelings do they bear?
Can Palamicia's silent blades strike down this power that incinerates all it touches?
The fiery fighter raises a new battle cry. Withstand his flame-wreathed fists of fury!
The beautiful divine swordswoman searching for a mighty opponent silently draws her blades. Stand against the greatest sword arm of the Gods!
The Silent Divine and Inferno God's eyes fill with delight. Face the superlative skill of two Gods at once!
Reigrad is under attack from countless monsters! Hurry back and save the city!
A man of few words introduces himself as a "Hero", offering help. Protect Reigrad with him!
As Rayas and friends fight to protect the city, the ultimate battle starts in the shadows.
Rayas and friends hold back the attacks on the city, while Roy's fight comes to a shocking end...
The alien invaders "Dark Matter" stormed the universe and arrived with Boros to Raktehelm...
Boros' tremendous power was sealed inside his armor. Now that is unrestrained, you have to face his true strength.
The Ruler scoured the galaxy for an equal. See his power now that his wish has come true!
The Gods and Demons, and all the races caught up in their conflict... This is a story of hope for those torn by unending enmity.
Early in the Ancient War, one sorcerer fought tooth and nail for his people, even as war swept over them.
Daki, a sorcerer in the 3rd Dove Brigade, heads to the front lines with his aide, a Meiol named Meo.
They pass on through the cave. It becomes a struggle to rejoin their squad, as enemies attack from places that should be clear.
Daki speaks to Meo about a man he can't seem to forget. Meo's soul feels the stirrings of fate.
The plains have become a battlefield, and Daki must cut his way through. Meanwhile, Meo cannot shake his doubts.
Why do we fight? wonders Meo. Even as the war rages around them, Daki listens closely.
Daki and Meo have passed through the plains and reached the wastelands. Even as they struggle with their doubts, enemies keep coming.
The dual sword-wielding warrior of the wasteland is that unforgettable man. Daki prepares himself even as he is assailed by doubt.
Meo's questions continue to echo. What lies beyond battle? And when the duel is decided...
A Demon of the 3rd Raven Brigade. Despite the powerful attacks, there is a softness to this swordsmanship...
The twin-blade warrior raises a battle cry. To rouse his own spirit, and to honor his mighty father.
The winged twin-blade warrior has unleashed his ultimate strength. What sights lie beyond this battle?
The Gods and Demons, and all the races caught up in their conflict... This is a story of hope for those torn by unending enmity.
Early in the Ancient War, one twin-blade warrior fought tooth and nail for his people, even as war swept over them.
Raki, a twin-blade wielder in the Third Demonic Infantry, heads for battle with his servant Gobl, Gobbie.
They head through the cave, struggling to rejoin their squad as enemies attack from places that should be clear.
Raki has an odd dream. Who was that man he saw? The answer comes to him in an unexpected way.
The God sorcerer facing Raki explains their relationship, but Raki finds it hard to believe.
A confused Raki fights but soon realizes... He and Daki share the same hopes.
Unexpected hands bring their fight to an end. The shrouded past is made clear at last.
A wall too high to overcome, for now... The two struggle with the fate of their servants.
The two have accepted their parents' hopes for them. Now, they can only trust that they will meet again.
A God of the 3rd Raven Brigade. His magic is overwhelming, and he is filled with steely resolve!
The sorcerer with the divine staff prays to rouse his own spirit as he thinks of his gentle mother.
The sorcerer with the divine staff unleashes his power. What sights lie beyond this battle?
The beast approaches you with a terrifying howl. Face it without being overwhelmed.
Zerkalo destroys all he sees. Resist the temptation of running away and fight him.
Stop with all your might the blow of the tragedy of the battle that Zerkalo pours out on you!
Rayas wakes up on a beach after getting caught up in a storm on his way to the island in the Far East...
An enemy attack! Sakura's blade is graceful, as much as lethal.
Rayas fights together with Sakura. The enemies begin to be overwhelmed by their offensive.
Sakura suddenly faints. Will Rayas be able to defend the city from the enemies alone?
When Sakura wakes up, she asks Rayas an unexpected question.
Sakura asks Rayas to summon her friend Yomi in order to see her once more.
Rayas follows Sakura to her and Yomi's favorite training ground.
The path to the training ground is full of monsters. It would be a difficult task for a normal person to even get there.
Scars from the past become visible, and the two girls' blades are extraordinarily sharp.
What is Sakura's real intention? Why did she call for Yomi?
Mira leans the Sakura Itto-Ryu techniques. Behold, her glittering dance and countless slashes!
Her swirling attack is almost like a storm of petals. Will you be able to face it?
The blade's attack is like a cherry tree in full blossom. Carve out the essence of the Sakura Itto-Ryu in your enemy!
The Machine Norn comes to Raktehelm. A young knight welcomes her...
Roy shares their orders, but Norn's attitude gets on his nerves.
Roy realizes Norn does feel some kind of emotion, and asks about her true motives.
Roy wants to know what Norn really thinks, but there is a profound gap between their worlds.
Roy and Norn continue their mission, though their relationship makes no progress. Roy slowly tries to break the ice.
Norn is changed somehow. She finally begins to open her eyes and heart to see what Humans really are.
Roy and Norn continue their information gathering journey. Along the way, they find unsettling news.
Roy and Norn continue their intelligence work. They're growing better at working together.
The pair investigate an ancient ruin, but its vast size begins to take a toll on their reserves.
A savage enemy appears before the exhausted pair. Roy and Norn make a "reasonable" choice.
"Your strength needs to be tested", Norn says as she readies her electromagnetic cannons. Her power is truly something else!
The warrior Norn came to Raktehelm to represent all Machines. She now bares her hidden power.
Norn has unleashed all her potential. Withstand her relentless firepower and grasp victory!
A Giant of Flames stands in the way of Rayas within the weathered ruins. Are you ready to survive his assault of fiery punches?
In front of Rayas stands an ancient Guardian Giant clad in flames. He's already lost what he once protected, so why does he still fight?
The Giant continues to go berserk within the ruins. Extinguish his raging flames and move ahead!
Rayas is looking for ingredients inside a cave, when a huge roar suddenly fills the air!
Rayas talks with Sugimoto and Asirpa in the cave. Who exactly are they?
Everyone has finished their meal and are resting for tomorrow when a mysterious roar fills the air once again.
Sugimoto and Asirpa have gone back to their world, but the story isn't over yet...
A mysterious white bird has shown up in the snow fields. It seems much stronger than the last monster.
The violent snow bird has strong magical powers. In the severe cold, it unleashes its full strength!

q.n: [SPEX] Giant Bird in the Snow Field
q.desc: The snow bird flies through the frozen fields. Fight back its attacks with all your might!
This bird of prey will not allow any intruders into its sanctuary. A white madness descends upon the frozen earth.

dungeons.n: The Hero and the Cursed Sword

q.desc: Rayas was invited to this restricted territory by the Hero. What is this secret trick to strength he mentioned?
Zeorg asks what the meaning of "hero" really is. What is behind that smile?
The strength to bring about the miracles spoken of in the epics... They continue, in pursuit of such power...

q.n: The Cursed Sword and the Hero
q.desc: The two move on, defeating the evil natural spirits dwelling in the Forbidden Forest. What is awaiting them ahead?
There was a man whose soul was devoured by a cursed sword... His story is one of foolishness... and sorrow.
The two leave the forest and enter a cavern. An ominous aura comes from its depths.
The Hero is urged to the depths by the legendary sword. It pulses as if hungering after new power.
The Hero of Famelle continues to question what a hero truly is. It's as if he's trying to cast off some lingering regret...
The two finally arrive at the end of the cave. The Hero suddenly steps to the sword, as he speaks of age and fate.
The Hero takes up the blade in a trance and bellows with rage. Can Rayas stop him?!
Zeorg has taken up the cursed sword. Can you withstand the blade's cunning assault?
The blade glows with baleful light. Show this grizzled veteran grinning behind its steel your true strength!
The Hero has repelled the evil temptation of the sword and made its power his own. Can you surpass the warrior mightier than ever?
The gaze lurking beneath the mask, peers at Rayas with unknown intentions. The masked man, with a grin on his face, seeks to...
The words he whispers in the midst of battle, "work of art", are filled with madness. You must not fall to the madness! You must overcome it!
As the fight intensifies the man's madness turns into a mixture of joy and twistedness. Put an end to his warped desires!
After losing the battle with Rayas, Ashe wakes up. He begins to walk on, alone, led by despair...
A town abandoned after a devasting magic experiment. There's not a single sign of human inhabitants...
Ashe's path takes him to an ominous forest. What portents lie in the twisted trees?
Ashe continues on the research-scarred path. Fragmented memories begin to surface.
Ashe enters the old research facility, and his path leads him to a once-forbidden ground.
Flowers are laid near the research documents. Someone has left them here in remembrance... But who?
A tree-filled garden lies just beyond the lab. The miasma-twisted trees cover the gate...
The rotted gate collapses at a touch. What memories does this flowering field hold for Ashe?
Ashe heads for Riiz Garden. Does he seek atonement at the massive grave, or something else?
Ashe finally arrives at the grave. What awaits him there?
The assassin Ashe was made powerful through sorcerous experiments. Surpass his dancing twin blades!
Countless blades out of the obscurity. Hit the dweller in the dark with a deadly shot!
Countless blades dance without a sound. Overcome the resolve smoldering in the assassin's eyes!
Leone is next in line for the throne after Princess Juno's death. Now her and her companions hold the kingdom's future in their hands.
Dielgrant is the nation bordering Granadia. It quietly bares its fangs to feed its leader's ambition.
Vox and the others take over the major training sessions. However, Berwick is nowhere to be seen.
The Templars keep training to be ready for their neighbor's strike. What enemy observes them now?
Young Leone bears enormous responsibility for her nation. And now, her dearest sister is replaced at her side by her Templars.
Leone and her friends go out shopping, and see a familiar face in the crowd.
Berwick is headed for a forbidden area. What is he up to?
The Dielgrant army has gathered at the border. There's not a moment to lose!
Berwick faces down Zelm's army by himself, and mows down his enemies with raging flames.
What is this that appears before Berwick? Now is the time to show his true power and save the kingdom!
An Ice Dragon suddenly appears in the sea of trees! Be ready to defend your nation with all your might!
The Ice Dragon's howls have turned the sea of trees to a frozen waste. Burn away the enemy's ambitions with your blazing spirit!
The Ice Dragon's absolute zero breath freezes all it touches. Burn away the ice and grasp victory!
He attacks, his fighting spirit blazing like the stars themselves! Fight for victory with all your body and soul!
Wild howls shake everyone to the bone. The group hurries off, leaving Berwick to cover their backs.
The female warrior who protects the Princess smiles as mighty enemies approach, swinging her axes.
Dielgrant's invasion moves ever forward. Who will stand before the invaders?
Only the strong survive in battle. The Templars' strength carries them forward.
The warriors are worn down by the ceaseless battle. The enemy sees its chance!
The warriors withstand coordinated, attack after attack. They must join the Princess, and fast!
Leone escapes her pursuers. But her heart is filled with thoughts of her exhausted warriors...
Though Leone has escaped her pursuers, she is now deep behind enemy lines. What awaits her now?
The will to fight lives on in the outnumbered warriors. The only way out he sees is--
The Juno Templars face off against Zelm. Now is the time to end this!
A being of pure darkness has appeared from the Otherworld. Hold back your terror, and stand against the beast!
Its talons gleam with hideous light. Destroy this dragon that feeds on your own fear!
Its howls drown out all other sound. End this grisly battle for once and for all!
The female warrior grins as she wields her deadly axes. Control her blows to grasp victory!
A figure goes racing by Rayas in the dark of night. It looks like it's holding a young girl!
A figure in black is sneaking past with a girl in its arms. This definitely calls for action!
Rayas goes to the Guild in search of news about the night shadow...
The Cult will do anything to achieve their goals. It appears they're connected to the Phantom Thief.
Rumors of the thief are spreading through the town, but no one knows his identity. Where could clues lie?
Rayas and friends are on the trail of Melia's secret. Who will win the battle of wits?
The calling card's time is coming soon. The team must be ready for the Phantom Thief!
Iris was abducted, and Melia is nowhere to be found. There's no way to pursue the thief now!
The theft was a success. However, Iris seems oddly heavy...
Rayas is taken aback by this unexpected enemy. Iris falls into Nier's clutches!
With a shriek of wind, demonic whips attack from a crack in the sky. Fear not, and face down Nier's ambitions!
The whips rain down in sadistic blows, sure to leave mortal wounds. Face down the battle-hungry succubus!
A whip cracks, hungry to feed the Demon's sadistic urges. Bring down the vicious Demoness!
All that fill those eyes is illusion... Strive to glimpse the Cult's fastest blades!
Every strike is imbued with the foul strength of the Ice Dragon.
Both his body and mind are turning into those of a Dragon's. He hungers for the power to stop that process.
Though his goal is distant, his spirit is adamant to overcome the many merciless battles ahead...

dungeons.n: Knights of Blood Act 2: "Famelle Defensive War" -Part 1-

q.desc: The Demons have prepared an alliance to fight the Gods. The Granadians head to join the royal round-table.
The Juno Templars have earned high expectations from earlier successes. But something seems amiss at this meeting...
The Templars are preparing to venture forth. Duke works out all alone...
Vox' feet quicken him toward the battle field as he senses a fierce fight coming. What thoughts are running through his head?
The Juno Templars arrive at the battlefield. A cunning Demon awaits them there.
After his promise with Riviera, Thetis feels anew his dedication to his nation and dear comrades.
The Demon Alliance has formed ranks and prepares to hold off the Gods. Riviera sets out on a scouting mission, but...
A new danger pursues Riviera in her recon party after Zelm's plan falls apart.
Thetis fights alone to protect what he must. And now no one can stop him.
Behind him is all he values. Soon the Gods will see that none shall pass his guard!
A proud knight stands before you. Break your way through!
The justice in her eyes blazes brighter than the sparks off her blade. You must surpass this ultimate swordswoman!
Her overflowing conviction falls as a shower of light. Get past her blade and defeat the knight!
The faith in his shield gives him endless strength. Break through that wall of steel and cut a path forward!
A myriad of Icicle Spears incessantly pour down in a frozen mist. Go through the deadly blow and show your power!

dungeons.n: Knights of Blood Act 2: "Famelle Defensive War" -Part 2-

q.desc: The war with the Gods is claiming ever more victims. This cannot stand, and those who can change it begin to move...
Vox proposes a daring surprise attack. His resolve offers the others courage.
The Juno Templars follow an untrodden path. The sky darkens as the sun begins to set.

q.n: Like the Wind, Like the Trees
q.desc: Vox hurries forward, with bated breath. The decisive battle approaches.
The Templars look down from the mountain at the enemy base. It's time to begin!
The surprise attack was no surprise. Divine blades thirst for Templar blood!
The blades of the Divine Knights topple one comrade after another. Can the outnumbered Templars turn the tables?
Two warriors, Vox and Nies, dominate the battlefield. The time for them to face off approaches.
Vox' efforts resound over the battlefield. Now the Invincible Shield of the Divine Knights stands before him.
The warrior's plea takes wings through a sky filled with hope and despair.
Nies, the leader of the Divine Knights, draws his blade without a sound. Face that blade-point without flinching!

q.n: [EX2] A Blow to Pierce the Heavens
q.desc: The mightiest blade of the Divine Knights grows ever sharper. Battle on, though death is all that awaits!
The will to battle slumbers in Nies' eyes. Strike now to end it all and defeat the supreme knight!
Vox has named you a sparring partner. Withstand his attacks and get past his blade!

dungeons.n: That Time I Summoned a SLIME

q.desc: Rayas and the others head to the mines to identify the cause of the mysterious rumbling of the ground.
A blue monster called slime appears in front of Rayas. It seems it's not a bad monster.
Benimaru, Rirumu's subordinate(?) joins the crew. The crew heads to the exit with the two.

q.n: At the Exit of the Mine
q.desc: It's almost the exit of the mines. Who is it that awaits the crew?
Rirumu named the Mikyuon "Mikyuo." It seems that Mikyuo likes Rirumu a lot.
Rayas and the others are now back in Reigrad. Rirumu is quite interested in the city.
Once again, the crew is heading to the mines to find Mikyuo's ore.
The mysterious ore that contains magic... This is their only clue to get the two back to their world.
Mikyuo guides the crew into the mines. Mikyuo somewhat seems to be in high spirits.
Rirumu feels anger towards the dragon that suddenly appeared. Now, his true powers are revealed...
Deep in the mines, the Haden Dragon shows itself. It'll cause a disaster if you don't stop it now!
The Haden Dragon is a dangerous species. Why did it appear near Reigrad?
It is said that a disaster will happen when the Haden Dragon appears. Its powers are now raging.
Play this limited-time Quest up to 5 times a day for boosted drop rates on Crossover Equips!
Solid, stinging, frenzied, crafty, strong. This foe is only for seasoned warriors.
The emissary of fire strikes from high and low. Fearless fighters will find their match here.

dungeons.n: That Time I Summoned a SLIME Part2

q.desc: The mysterious hand Mikyuo drew and the old man who appeared. What is going to happen?
A young girl appeared at the same time as Rimuru and Benimaru. Who is this girl who calls them besties with Rimuru?
Rimuru absorbs Magicules and mimics a human shape. His fading memories start returning.
The appearance of Rimuru, Benimaru and the dragon. This cave must hold some clues.
Rayas and the others trek deeper into the cave. Who resides in its depths?
The Summoner, Dolon is somewhat deranged, but has incredibly dangerous plans. He holds the key to all!
Dolon planned to summon the Fallen Beast God. They must stop his ambition!
Demon Lord Milim defeated the Fallen Beast God in a single blow. Dolon immediately flees, so the team pursues.
Rayas and the others chase Dolon. But Dolon still hasn't given up. Keep cautious!
Mikyuo has evolved to repay his debt to Rimuru. You must answer his call to action!

dungeons.n: Knights of Blood Act 3: "The Coffin in the Sky" -Part 1-

q.desc: The skies of Granadia haven't changed in two years. Except for one thing...
Rosetta is a gifted sorcerer. The mood feels somehow oppressive.
Riviera speaks of past events. Something happened at a blazing shrine.
Berwick has lost his sorcery. His face grows tight with frustration.
Rosetta joins in the Templars' battle training. Soon, her true ability is revealed.
Rosetta has her doubts about the source of Magia Drive. She heads to the Academy Library.
Berwick ventures through the forest alone. His spirit wrestles with memories of that day.
We don't need anyone who can't fight-- Duke's words are carved deep into his heart.
Chasing Berwick, Rosetta gets lost in the forest. Something comes from above--
A sword is found in the Granadia Castle dungeon. It holds the memory of a lost swordsman.
The Goddess's cursed blade brings death to all opponents. Search for survival amidst the flashing attacks.
This spear of calamity rains down destruction. Dodge its attacks to land a single blow of death.
The ruler of the underworld smiles grimly-- Strike down the haughty God!
Brand an image of your blazing sword on the enemies’ souls!

dungeons.n: Knights of Blood Act 3: "The Coffin in the Sky" -Part 2-

q.desc: Rosetta prepares for the ceremony with a specially-made item.
The genius girl keeps her heart closed off, but she has her worries.
Rosetta continues her research into Magia Drive at the academy. She thinks back to a smiling face...
Rosetta is planning to break into the lab. The key to her plan is a certain someone...
Rosetta finds a book in the lab: a record of the Queens of Granadia.
The Leone Templars are preparing for the Coffin Ceremony. A tense atmosphere fills the Granadian night.
Leone faces this fateful day with all the resolve of a queen.
Suddenly, the air is filled with flames. Leone grows afraid of the power running in her veins.
Rosetta and Duke search for the queen. What stands in their way?
Leone stops... The sights of that day still lingers in her heart...
The soaring darkness turns its talons on you. Cut through the roaring winds of evil and bestow punishment!
A warp in reality defends the beast. Focus all your strength on a single point of attack!
This God shows power beyond the ken of man...
The witch writes runes to rain blows like falling stars...
The team serves as Captain Forte's escorts as she travels to another country. Wade through the monsters infesting the path like true heroes!
The team will soon arrive at their destination. Gather information, but don't miss the train!
The Arcana Express is on the move, but the delayed departure has Captain Forte in a bad mood.
The escorts fight atop the train while Forte stays inside. What do the ambush troops want?
The ambush troops keep coming. Forte may be in danger inside, but currently, your hands are full!
It's time to disembark. The entrance to a vast forest almost seems to beckon you inside...
The Lost Woods is deeper and darker than imagined. As they travel through the forest, the past of Forte is revealed.
The captain and her escorts have grown closer. They must get through the long journey to Gala together!
The group searches for a place to spend the night in safety. What does Kane reveal to Forte, illuminated by the light of the moon?
The Giant loses control of himself in his rage. Fight together, but be careful!
This ancient city lost its grandeur in an ancient flood. Now, it is the domain of a Giant.
The Giant fights relentlessly. It's almost like he's saying for the party to pay for invading the holy ground...
The maddened Giant continues to fight. To defeat the creature, you must first survive its onslaught of attacks!
Light glints off the muzzle of a gun as it points in your direction...
The Dragon's strike slices through the earth! Dodge the warrior's fierce attacks and discover the firm resolve hidden behind her fury!
The group rushes away from the Giant's dwelling, deeper into the ruins. All they can do is pray that their comrade is safe.
Ru and the others keep a look out for Fen as they move on. The deep silence of the ruins seems to swallow all sound.
As Forte and her team move on, her soldiers report to the King back home.
The soldiers and townspeople alike pray that the peace conference succeeds, and await the captain's return.
They have finally left the ruins. Ru thinks back on what Kane said when planning this escort duty.
Despite the lack of cover, attackers continue to come from nowhere. What could they be after?
The muzzle of a gun shines in the light. Awaiting Forte and her companions beyond the ruins is a gunman clad in black.
Forte and her companions have finally reunited with Fen. They can see a castle in the distance. They will soon arrive at Garrah!
Upon arriving at Garrah, the travelers are greeted by a warm welcome.
A few days have passed since the peace conference. Forte announces she is parting ways with her escorts and returning home. However...
A demon bird sleeps in this marsh. They say that disturbing its sleep would mean the end for a foolish adventurer.
A piercing shriek echoes over the marshes. Has the bird found new prey at last? Dodge its swooping talons!
Its wingbeats crush rock, and its howl shakes the ground... Penetrate the marsh and bring down the mighty beast!
Time to give everything I've got! Can you withstand this relentless assault?
A man in full plate armor appears at Reigrad's Adventurer's Guild. Who could he be?
Gobls rampaging at a farm, and adventurers from another world... This marks the start of a journey full of mystery.
Rayas' party heads for a farm outside of town. They need to hear what Lute has to say.
Lute was witness to the chaos at the farm. The boy's eyes are filled with worry.
The Priestess stammers out her story.  It's a recollection of their time before coming to Raktehelm.
The High Elf Archer leads Goblin Slayer through the quiet woods. They are near the ruins now...
The team has reached the forest ruins.  What are Goblin Salyer's thoughts before the Gobl's lair?
Rayas and friends spot two familiar figures as they head deep into the ruins.
Lute faces his fears. He recalls a past mischief...
Countless goblins appear before them. The armored man reveals his bloodlust...
Better chance to get Crossover Equips! One time per day only "Bonus Quest".
Ax has lost all reason. His body has been overcome by endless madness.
Ax absorbs all the hatred around him, gaining incredible power. You must stop this monster!
This massive goblin has seen the power to surpass time and space. End this battle of misery.
A Giant of disaster appears from the frozen wastes. Stop the destruction it brings, and seal it away again!
Granadia is forced in a life-or-death battle, but the flame of hope burns still!
Berwick senses the Divine Knights. He feels a showdown approaching.
Rosetta finishes working out the Crest Sorcery formula, and now she's repairing the Coffin. It's a battle with time!
Leone has sworn not to approach the Coffin. Rosetta's face fills with relief.
The Gods Army attacks. The Bloody Battle begins in northern Granadia.
Nies easily parries Berwick's onslaught. Truly, this is the strongest of the Divine Knights.
Berwick does not rest his hand. His blade strikes ever faster.
Rosetta finishes repairing the Coffin. Now, the counter-attack begins!

q.n: A Flash in the Blue Sky
q.desc: The Sky Ark's magical cannons belch flame. They must drive the Gods Army out from Granadia!
At the end of the fierce fighting, the young girl says a prayer for the world sinking into darkness...
The knight of the heavens brandishes her sword. Strike with all your body and soul!
Her cutting edge glitters as it grazes your cheek. Stand firm, and show your might!
Two Divine Knights stand before your eyes. They are ready to unleash unbridled power!
The Princess' blood paints the woodlands crimson...

dungeons.n: Knights of Blood Act 4: "Bloody Battle of the Capital" -Part 2-

q.desc: Granadia has been painted crimson, as if the queen's blood stained every inch.
The Divine Knights have regrouped, but a dark wind blows toward them.
Seeing the damage wrought upon his army, the knight makes a hard decision.
Miasma flows from the people toward Granadia's Castle.
Duke already knows the truth of the jet-black armor hidden below the ruins.
Duke confronts the armor of destiny below Granadia's Castle.
The Stars show their anger at the unending war between Gods and Demons.
The Ancient Titan has awakened below the castle. The Stars' fury comes for Leone.
The Princess' wish embraces the whole world, encompassing all her hopes and dreams.
Time passes, and green shoots return to Granadia.
The Titan's rage falls like lightning. Defend yourself before its might!
This spirit of calamity was born of the Stars' will. Fight to survive, with all your body and soul.
The howls of this hollow spirit fill the air with despair. Carve your superhuman power into its flesh!
Our pledge to our ruler! The call to justice running deep in our crimson blood!

dungeons.n: Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll -Act 1-

q.desc: The Shinobi have chosen to live in peace. Still, they never forget to train to protect themselves.
The Shinobi lived a self-sufficient life in tune with the seasons. Or at least, they believed so...
The sun was setting, as it always did. But ominous clouds came in from the west.
It was so sudden... Having different desires, war cries rose from the Shinobi.
Amane, Yakuno village's first line of defense, stands before Shiki and Saku.
Mizuki from Imari, Shuri from Yakuno... Deadly blades clash in battle.
Imari Village was harshly damaged by Yakuno's sudden attack.
Shiki is striving for even greater strength, but what does Mizuki, burdened with the village, have in mind?
Hope, duty, loneliness, and pride... The village's defenders are in confusion.
The guideposts to the village's hopes and future are smeared with sadness and blood.
The beast is filled with an evil spirit. A soul-devouring creature raises its birth cries.
Its breath rots flowers, and its bellow soils the sky.
This evil beast, emanating ominous waves, has lost its mind and has become an incarnation of destruction.
What are they craving for? A tide of raging blood awakens the power to slaughter monsters.

dungeons.n: Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll -Act 2-

q.desc: One cannot understand the value of a peaceful life until one experiences dreadful days.
Ominous creatures stand in the gap between life and death. The shinobi must ready his blades.
Illusions surround Saku and bare their fangs. They offer no respite as the air fills with the stink of blood.
The circle of the moon rests in the sky. A shadow steals up on Saku as he is lost in thought.

q.n: Waiting for Whom Will Not Come
q.desc: Kisaragi and the other wait for Saku in the village. Everyone is worried about his absence.
Saku has finally returned. Everyone raises their hands in triumph at his success.
The message stroke like a cold shower, and sent ripples through the heart of all who hear it.
The unease grows into chaos and sends echoes through history.
Kisaragi has thrown off her hesitation and stands resolute before Shuri.
Everyone strives for someone, but no one knows the despair that is coming closer.
This girl did not hesitate to find ways to make up for what she lacked.
She altered herself in pursuit of strength... To love and to be loved.
Once a girl, the Slaughter Doll stood there... She beautifully started the battle.
An encounter with the two heads of the village. Raging flames and relentless hammers come on the attack.
Innumerous monsters come swarming from the ruins. The whole of Isliid is in danger!
The monster swarm threatens Reigrad. Rayas and Ganan defend the town, but then someone appears...
The monsters begin attacking all over Isliid. Disaster strikes all around!
One of our friends gets wrapped up in the threat... But fate brings along an unexpected encounter.
Everyone gives their all to defend the town. And then... He appears.
Rayas and Genos head to the ruins, only to meet someone truly powerful. But the strongest man is approaching the heart of the matter...
One man controls the ruins and spreads destruction. He is insane!
The cornered man calls up a forbidden entity. No normal warrior could defeat it...
The warriors fall one by one before the crimson beast. But he is on his way...
Roy and Saitama escape by the skin of their teeth. Now is not the time for words. They let their fists do the talking.
This beast calls itself "Destroyer of Worlds". It is no ordinary monster...
This crimson beast calls itself "Heart of Envy". Put its massive destructive power to rest!
No one, no matter how strong, is immortal. Show the Destroyer its fate.
These heroes have awakened power that transcends time and space. Now, show them one single, all-powerful hit!
A soul bathed in blood seeks out for battle. With a hunger that cannot be satiated, save for victory.

dungeons.n: Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll -Act 3-

q.desc: The wounds have started to heal, but are still tender. Even with the slightest touch, the scar still hurts.
Mindless, rotten, implacable... A procession of the dead spirits begins.
She would do anything for her. She would believe anything if she said so.
Though she had seen it only once, the gentle light took her heart and soul.
The bizarre spectacle spreads in silence. Mizuki and Shiki stand fast.
The threat has passed. Now, Mizuki trudges toward its source.
Ena, a nation that vanished in a single night... Now the truth is revealed.
The poison spreads steadily. No one knows how much time remains.
Sealed for 1,000 years... The lid of the cauldron flies off with a piercing laugh.
It's a mere coincidence that she was born at this time. But still, she must gain that strength.
Clear each hurdle and slay the living. This is the realm of the dead. It reeks, and it is dark.
It is the realm of the dead. It reeks and it's dark... Rotten flesh wraps around your body...
It has lost all pain, all sadness, and all suffering. All that is left in their shredded flesh is rage.
When the gleam of red eyes heralds, death approaches and those who try to escape will find their souls shredded.

dungeons.n: Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll -Act 4-

q.desc: Tamae's plan is moving forward, and the ninjas are trapped in the middle.
Mizuki and Kisaragi face down the capital, now a dead city filled with evil spirits.
The master will lay the foundation for the road ahead. The orders will now be fullfilled...
Forward, with hearts steeled by pain and misery.
When they finally reached the entrance of the castle, they found Shiki standing there.
The girl is in deep sorrow. Now the suspicious fools dance.
Those who were scattered gather once more. When wills overlap, strength is born.
They gather beneath the full moon, according to the ancient law. An awakening soul cries out to the sky.
The time has come for darkness of the underworld and the darkness of the human heart to come together.
The wish is fulfilled... They stand tall for the sake of someone.
After all these long centuries, the Demon Fox Ugetsu has returned. And with her comes untold rage and hate.
Gods, Demons, Humans... All races bow before this majestic aura.
Her howls tear heaven and earth, and raise a sea of blood.
The grand Fox's power is the source of countless evils. Now, taste deep of that darkness.
You may wish for all this to be a terrible nightmare. The Demon Fox, touched by towering rage rends the earth.
A throng of Mokyuon appear on a sunny hill. Fight them off to restore peace!
The Mokyuon regroup and attack. Stand fearlessly and mow them down!
The crowding Mokyuon rush in. Avoid getting caught in the stampede!
Mokyuon attack in droves, blanketing the ground. Don't be daunted by their numbers!
Endless Mokyuon march through the forest. Wipe them out all at once!
The land trembles beneath the crazed Mokyuon. Carve a path through them!
Mokyuon as far as the eye can see. Wield your weapons to seize victory!
Waves of Mokyuon even topple the trees. Pierce through the horde to stop them!
The Mokyuons' fury shakes the air. Dig deep and eradicate them!
Herds and herds of Mokyuon approach. Don't stop until they're all gone!
A mountain of Mokyuon towers above you. The battle is far from over.

Right before their long-awaited vacation, the Fenrir Corps gets surprised by a job from the information bureau.
The agent's carefree personality drives the methodical captain up the wall.
An already frustrated Roy gets thrown into an ordeal that is all but pleasant.
The suspect leads the two to a certain someone's mansion.
Surrounded by a group of angry-looking thugs, Roy prepares to do some negotiating with his blade.
There's only one person who could have been in the back of that carriage...
Emptiness is the only proof of solitude one needs.
His trigger finger trembles not out of fear, but anger.
The only sounds one can hear over his enemy's screams are from his gun barrels.
In response to his partner's confession, Roy gives up words for bullets.
Practice makes perfect. Help the fervent Roy with his training.
Shoot, shoot, shoot some more. These guns never overheat!
Roy lets his guns do the talking. And he wants to chat.
The captain unleashes a newfound power. Step into his territory and show him how it's done!
Beneath the moonlight, her blades strike without cease. Cut through the whirling tempest!
Steps move in time to the rhythm of clashing blades. Feel the heat of her passion!
Her performance reaches the climax. Face the keen edge of her conviction!
Wings flutter in a carefree light. Everyone believed their path was righteous...
All three are thinking of someone in particular... And they pray there is no curse waiting to fall.
They work together to face danger. Their hearts are one. When they join forces, nothing is impossible.
They fight for those they love. For as long as their flame burns...
The capital has suffered a mysterious monster attack. But Cestina and her siblings are working to keep spirits high.
The royal family uses all their powers, and each brings success in their own way.
It's like being pulled into a bottomless swamp. It traps the hands, the feet, and even the voice...
Luahn and the people might truly be the same. Neither can seem to escape the darkness shrouding them.
Oluon reborn in Gran Verge... Both a dream, and a duty to be fulfilled.
The collapsed tower cannot tell its story. Yet the wind shrieking through the cracks carries the sound of grief.
Not once, but twice... Is it a curse, or mere coincidence? Whatever the case, great wings once more shred the sky.
The defenders, and the defended. Roles given, not chosen. But those who take the situation for granted are in for a rude awakening.
Fear and anxiety, rage and grief... They sharpen the beast's fangs, and harden its heart.
Everyone nearly forgot... But love without boundaries finally reminds them of the righteous path.
Its breath falls like sighs of resignation, despair, and regret, and freezes all it touches.
What do these beating wings seek? They spread like greedy hands, grasping for something they cannot have.
The beast's fangs drip with ichor. It is more than blood that stains those rending white blades.
The beast grins, as if to show how depraved it truly is. Defeat it. O warrior whose hand knows the blade, take up your weapon!
The blaze of fighting spirit wraps his body, eyes glinting through the swirling heat.

q.n: The Sun Sets on Gran Verge
q.desc: The dinner table is bustling as the four royal siblings gather around. Each is fired up for their new duties.
As the nation readies itself for a grand festival, Liza is working overtime to prepare.
Not only is Liza in charge of the festival, she is working on Oluon's restoration as well.
Liza, hidden away in Oluon, is filled with resolve to fulfill the hope it represents.
Liza works day and night to decipher the control rites, but progress is painfully slow.
Work goes on, one step after another, yet Oluon still slumbers.
A single seat at the table remains empty, and the silence it brings is deafening.
Liza continues to struggle, even as she contemplates the magical fireworks that once inspired her.
As she reaches out to grasp the dazzling light, she fails to see the shadows gathering behind her.
Sounds thrown into disarray create cacophony. So, too, do hopes and dreams that veer off course.
Reverberating rumbles and piercing shrieks accompany this nightmarish scene.
The gargantuan creature spreads fear and anguish: a rondo of pure terror, played again and again.
Gnashing fangs, spilled blood, shrieks, and howls. The twin-headed monstrosity conducts a quartet of destruction.
Break through the fear cast by those four baleful eyes. Prove yourself worthy of the title adventurer!
Revolving blades whine with cold aggression, prepared to rend the world itself.

dungeons.n: Spy in the Shadows - Forte's Mission

q.desc: Forte having returned from her mission to Garrah shares her adventures with her squad.
Forte was escorted by men from a faraway land. Her soldier's listen to her tales in awe.
The Peace Treaty's signing set the events in motion, teaching Forte many new lessons.
To acquire the fuel that the Arcane Express needs to operate, they must risk entering the mines.
Forte asks King Garrah for special assistance with a very unusual proposal.
Forte sought help from Fen and Kane. But she seems to have an ulterior motive as well...
Their plan was perfect...but little did they expect trouble lurking in the shadows...
Their pursuers were behind the Garrah attack! Forte and Kane await, gun and blade in hand!
Kane fights off the attackers, Forte arrives at the mines, and Fen makes an interesting discovery.
The Shadow Guardians have finally cornered the attackers. This fight will end their evil plans!
Forte's special training is not for the weak! Win this fight to prove yourself as a soldier!
Forte's special training part 2 begins! There is no finish line in the pursuit of greatness!
Part 3 of Forte's special training! Bring your best to battle, no excuses allowed!
With both beauty and brawn, this young Commander leads the shadow army!
Gods and Dragons are to destined become the greatest of friends... or the greatest of enemies.
Spreading its wings, it beckons fear and reveration from those that bare witness. Its name is Virago.
The princes and princesses are accused of crimes they don't remember committing: treason and attempted regicide.
The prison is deep underground. Its cold walls swallow all sound.
For an average person, steel walls would suffice, but for the princes and princesses need more than that to keep them in.
They must go and find proof of their innocence.
The home they knew until yesterday is no more. What has changed, though? The place, or their memories of it?
The princes and princesses escape. They hurry to the castle for an audience with the king.
They shared bonds beyond mere father and child. For this young man, following his father's path was a dream.
What mistake led to all of this? Hope as we might for an answer, we hope in vain.
The condemned are sent to the headsman.
There is no escaping this parting. As the stars themselves fall, they turn their backs on glory.
All she wanted was approval, like so many others...
A life destined for mockery and ridicule? No, perhaps not... The dragon awakes.
None has survived the dragon's raging touch. It consumes all...
It needs nothing, wants nothing. The rage it sends forth rends its throat.
The princes and princesses have escaped and are hiding deep in a nameless wood.
Life at the abbey is not what they're used to, but they still enjoy the peace and tranquility it brings.
Out picking herbs, Milay encounters a Dragon girl in distress.
The archives below the abbey are home to a trove of forgotten wisdom.

q.n: Those Who Turn from the Light
q.desc: It may just be the moonlight, but the thought persists... If only they'd met under different circumstances.
Angelas searches for the source of her aching pain and is troubled by the memories burned into her brain.
As Cestina is overcome with regret, Liza swims in the sea of wisdom.
A legend is written in a tome that had been lying dormant. Liza's heart flutters as she is lost in time.
The woods are dyed crimson, and the sky itself burns. The dragon's cries bring raging flames.
Even if she is rejected, she will keep trying--for the sake of her weaker past self.
The touch of the dragon's blaze will burn you where you stand.
The dragon's mere gaze can melt flesh from bone.
The ground blazes, and the very air robs you of life.
A girl escapes and runs into the forest in search of light. Overcome the challenges and grasp the future!
It's a turning point for the rookie Salyssa. Her assigned unit, however, is a bit...
Knights are not just about fighting. The Stella Squad's responsibilities are many.
A knight's duties extend to the most unusual of places with varying necessity.
What the Stella Squad defends is vague and intangible.
Ashleigh threw away personal glory to become a PR squad leader.
Fine arts and emotional fervor abound in the Principality of Bamint.
The Funereal Bloom adorns the stage as the classic tale unfolds.
The rookie's passion is tested in light of the truth.
The Stella Squad melts even the most frigid of hearts.
Salyssa resolves herself once more to find her place...
Get in line for a one-on-one lesson with the Captain.
Experience Captain Ashleigh's routine in this special issue of Minchenne Monthly.
Playtime's over. Taste the true might of a Rose Garden Knight.
Pour your soul into dismantling the Demon's sinister machinations.
Stand, fight, and overcome the dazzling bond of the witch and the warrior.
The Stella Squad stirs to action after hearing about prohibited artwork.
Thoughts may become clouded, but the emotion behind them remains lit.
Mira and the Luna Squad tail the suspect behind the disappearances.
Salyssa pursues the art store owner, unaware of the darkness that awaits.
It's more than mere impatience that spurs Salyssa onward.
That knight's blade strikes out to calm wavering hearts.
Salyssa reignited their fervor to push back against convention.
The disgusting truth behind the underground paintings is revealed.
Witness the fiery passion of Stella Squad!
Ashleigh's truth is revealed, and Salyssa makes a decision.
Slay the monster that imperils the nation's fervor.
Unsheathe the sword against a monster ignorant of the pen.
Rise up against the dark imposter of zeal.
Test the might of this country-girl-turned-soldier.
While Rayas and Iris are investigating a cave, a band of heroes find themselves in trouble in another world.
A flash of light envelops Naofumi's party. They seem to be heading somewhere.
Rayas struggles in a cave battle, resulting in a Summon with unexpected results...
The young man summoned calls himself "Naofumi Iwatani." It seems he's not ready to trust Rayas yet.
Naofumi walks the streets alone. He's surprised by the townsfolk who welcome him with warm words.
Rayas finds Naofumi and starts talking... Naofumi attempts to keep his distance, but...
Naofumi, summoned from another world, shows interest in the new world he finds himself in.
Naofumi tells Rayas he's interested in joining Reigrad's Guild.
As Naofumi talks to people, he comes to understand that everyone has a story.
Naofumi's decision pleases Raphtalia and friends. Rayas and Iris are happy to send them off.
The Guild has ordered you to exterminate a herd of monsters. Clear the infested dark wetlands!
The herd of monsters has appeared again. Follow their roar that shakes the wetlands!
The monsters obey the Life Draining Botanical Beast! Free the land from this pest's tentacles of madness!
Survive the beast's onslaught and let your inner strength shine through!

The princes and princesses find comfort in their temporary home, where they can speak without reserve.
Someone is after the royal children, and for him, this forest has a deeper meaning.
The resolve to shoulder every burden is honed by every painful step.

q.n: Time to Come, Time to Go
q.desc: The fated day has come. Nothing lasts forever...
The princes and princesses follow a rugged trail. Out here, they are treated the same as everyone else.
Everyone is glad they are traveling together. Not even the scariest story can frighten them now.
A destroyed village waits at the edge of the forest. That was where they first crossed paths.
Did this place give birth to the evil spirits, or was it their own hearts?
A long-burning vengeance is now ready to bear deadly fruit!
On that day, this village was filled with blood and flame. What did these two young people witness?
The agony of their parting not only tore the siblings apart? it also tore out his beating heart.
No one knows the origins of this raging beast, but it must be stopped.
All that moves will be devoured, and all life extinguished.
The beast sleeps in the flames of hell, hidden behind the peaceful face of a girl.
This beast devours without thought. It obeys only its instinct to lay waste to the earth.
Once, they were innocent children, but then came a day of tragedy that tore their family apart.
They set out on their journey with hope in their hearts, but their fingers still trembled.
They gaze upon a lush island with a grand tower rising from its center.
The miasma flows deep through the woods. A flower blooms, fed by fleeting wishes.
The dragon's breath weighs heavy... It burns both the body and the spirit.
After the dark dragon left, the two of them vanished. Where did they go?
Iscator offers no barriers to anyone hoping to enter.
The tower was designed to harass intruders. None will get close to the truth it hides.
It should have been empty, but...
Is it mere coincidence that they have gathered here, where it all began?
Rejection, evasion, isolation, pain, and repression come forth in a cry of misery.
The dragon has been consumed by the miasma.  The agony wracking its body begins to transform into pleasure.
The howls are close. The incarnation of destruction will consume all before anybody notices.
The dream of embracing you will never come true, and so the dragon wails.
The dragon knows nothing of beginnings and endings. It simply rages within the barriers set upon it.
Rayas and Roy set out after the four travelers, who had said something mysterious before disappearing.
The monsters appearing in the plains are far too wild. Something bad must be happening...
Four warriors battle monsters deep in the forest. Who are they, and why are they so powerful?
Rayas and Roy continue their search. They hear a distant roar and follow it through the forest.
After defeating a violent monster and reaching the deepest part of the forest, Rayas and Roy come across a surprising sight.
They leave the forest and arrive at a ruined city, dodging crazed beasts as they go forth.
Finally, they find the four warriors. One of them has a look of suspicion on his face.
Rayas is impressed with the four, and they form an alliance to reach their shared goal.
The six split into two teams to defeat more monsters. They seem to be working well together.
They uncover the source of the ominous aura. Can they defeat the mighty enemy before them?
Test your strength against this powerful tag team from another world. Fight back against their incredible teamwork!
The four mighty warriors were created by alchemy. Evade wave after wave of their lightning-fast attacks!
The warriors have survived terrible battles. Their strong bond is a force to be reckoned with.
A state attained only by those who reach perfection-- Can you withstand a blow from such lofty heights?

q.n: The Night of the Red Moon
q.desc: Their father dead, Luahn a traitor... But the story is not over. No, it has only just begun!
Chloe tells the story of those days at Iscator, where this all began.
The servants serving the princes and princesses each have things that they treasure.
Victoire's powerful performance breathes new life into lost memories.
Memories of the Ancient Blood, who created the Towers of Providence, are woven from pure sound.
The past is now laid bare. Is there any hope at the end of the path?
The princes and princesses head for Gran Verge, hearts filled with resolve and duty.
Simple words bring unity and nurture strength against opposition.
Chloe hurries to Luahn. Her heart is filled with frustration, anxiety, and a glimmer of hope.
Her hopes will reach him. They always have, and they always will.
Purity that brings forth madness and cruelty... Her melody harmonizes all three of these elements.
The dark ruler has been called forth. Cursed words mingle with every breath.
Neither eternal nor ephemeral, these bubbles of darkness drift away and vanish.
A faithful servant approaches out of the darkness to guide the way to oblivion.
The darkness grows and swallows all the light, but if light vanishes, so does the dark...
The prince and princesses have returned to Gran Verge to save their nation, their people, and yes... their brother.
What Victoire truly wants is a secret only known to her.
There is a clash of hopes in Gran Verge. Everyone fights to make their own hopes come true.
There was tragedy unresolved along with comedy they had thought they understood.
The mark at his breast gleams red and black, as a promise for the end of all.
True fear comes from the greed of the weak, and the destroyer brings punishment to them all.
The Great God brings absolute destruction. To rage, to sorrow, to kindness, to dreams, to yesterday, to tomorrow...
They do not know if they can win. But if they do not fight, there is no hope.
Some just lose their way. Some truly believe. Some live for justice. And some are consumed by duty.
Seize them all--this day, and every other one, as we wade through the river of sorrow.
He is never truly alone, but the loneliness he felt was bone deep.
What he desired was neither sympathy nor concern. He only wanted acceptance.
Just as the spirit wears thin, a sound begins to approach. Something dark walks this way...
The Great God's descent heralds the end. The curtain will fall on dreams and on reality.
The domain of the Great God denies the very fabric of existence.
His dark eyes were like black holes. With a glance, I knew he was my lord.
I have long overcome this lingering pain, but he stopped the blood pouring from my heart.
Volcanic ruins emerge from another world. When the tyrant's roars are silenced, a bright light will shine.
The winged guardian appears from another world. When it crashes to the ground, the melody of dawn will play
Dragons with mastery over life and death appear. Break the jade fangs and raise them high in triumph.
This Exploring temple leads to the land of the dead. The divine arachnid offers new strength to victors!

dungeons.n: Knights of Blood: Zero -Part 1- "Dawn of Granadia"

q.desc: Few could create something where there is nothing. She is one of those few.
Watching her pour her very life into her dream, he finds himself hoping for her success.
Before anyone realizes, people are gathering at her side. Eager to follow the path she blazes.
Who was it that said the nail that sticks out gets hammered down? They must have known this day was coming.
A general does not stand above, nor guide the way. A general shares their will, and offers strength.
They have already found a place they can't give up. And now the world welcomes Granadia.
She smiled that Granadia itself is a one of a kind treasure. However, its path had already begun to stray.
Noble wishes and pure intentions must bow to the power of the Crimson Blood.
Anxiety leads to impatience, and impatience breeds rage. The unreachable distance creates despair...
Was it resignation that drew her near? Now, the Crimson Blood boils within her responding to her wish.
Her power repels, and breeds hate. And she laughs in pride!
This wall must be passed. But no one warned of the hatred and death it brings!
Hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands... As the Giant endlessly slaughters, it finally realizes something.
Unity. That pure, evil intent has consumed the titan.
A grand figure swathed in blue fabric. Its howls of sadness and rage pierce your ears.
A mechanical fortress sealed in the otherworld. The blood-oiled mechanisms churn restlessly.

dungeons.n: Clashing Thunder of the Emerald Bird【Ultra】

q.desc: A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Only a dauntless blade will shear its wings.
A forbidden power rests in this ominous shrine. The laughing shadow awaits his next offering.

dungeons.n: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in a Summoner's World -Part 1-

q.desc: It was just another day in Reigrad, without anything strange in sight.
A brief walk through the grassfield out of the forest and away comes the unfamiliar town of Reigrad.
Roy stands awatch in Reigrad, with orders from the Emperor as the story begins.
In exchange for lodging, Subaru and the others show off their housework skills.
Subaru helps around the inn with Roy. After what feels like an eternity...they go shopping.
A smell in the air and the sound of monsters. Something that has repeated an untold number of times.
Rem and the Alchemist Rem. Though their names may be identical, their appearances and personalities are worlds apart.
Rem's intuition is not to be underestimated. Subaru chases after Rayas in search of the truth.
Subaru returns to the inn after having spoken his true feelings.
The inability to ignore or pretend are the prime qualities of a gullible person.
Crossover Equipment has a higher chance to drop on this limited once per day quest!
A monster that appears from anywhere. Fear emanates from the wicked magic beast.
A place of no return. Even if able to cut down thousands, the monsters are unkillable.
Even the strongest perish like petals dancing in a storm of blood. The scythe thirsts again.
Fear to approach. For you bring rise to the name which must not be said.

dungeons.n: Knights of Blood: Zero -Part 2- "The Crimson Queen"

q.desc: Berwick finds the sound of the wind in the forest leaves somehow unsettling.
He was saved by an azure warrior. What gives that blade its dazzling gleam?
Stumbling into the water-side training ground, Berwick spots the warrior once more.
A glimpse of light brought by that warrior changes the sorcerer's life.
The tower offers a view of the whole city. Each and every streetlight was as a priceless jewel to the pair.
All the trees and flowers of the city are wilting. The people are gripped by growing unease.
He would be stronger than anyone. It is the only way to reach that light.
With every step on the damp earth and rotten leaves, the sound grows more unsettling.
No more fear, no more resistance... The swordsman goes out to fulfill his great oath.
The living must face what comes, and carry on the wishes of those who have gone.
The blood boils... It would be so easy to surrender to the ecstasy it brings.
Sing and Dance and Rage and Laugh and Scream and Weep. Gouge and Shred and Crush and Rend and Kill.
Long, long ago,  it incarnated to destroy everything...
Who could have called it here? A fool, praying only for destruction. The world itself mocks the murderous spirit.

dungeons.n: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in a Summoner's World -Part 2-

q.desc: Once again, from here.... In Reigrad a second time, his battle begins.
Having sworn to fight.... that very determination opens up the path to new possibilities.
Within the flow of time, everyone changes little by little. To move forward, to protect, little by little change occurs.
The priestess' prayers in the temple are interrupted by a mysterious voice.
The black cat reveals itself to give Liese an unexpected task: solve the ring of thefts in Reigrad.
Liese is unsure if she can meet expectations, but she faces the fresh challenge with a smile.
The priestess, discovering the thorny path that awaits her, is at a rare loss for words.
The small clue Liese found at the restaurant was only a glimpse of her talent.
The priestess takes hold of her grandmother's mementos -- a silent gesture of commitment.
All legends, no matter how grand, have humble beginnings. Hers is no different.
Seasoned sleuths can find meaning in even the most subtle actions.
Liese connects the dots in her head, but she knows completing the picture requires solid proof.
After overcoming a multitude of trials, the master detective gives her answer.
She still has much to learn, but that does nothing to dampen her joy.
Her spirit of inquisitiveness takes over. She continues the search until the case is solved.
A hideous plant roars like a beast. Its vines lash out to surround prey.
Part vegetation, part animal, all-devouring. This golden monster seeks power with unwithered greed.

q.n:
Despair of the Cursed Armor X
[BGN]
q.desc: Red metal rises from the murky swampland. Murderous intent smolders beyond the helmet.

q.n:
Despair of the Cursed Armor X
[INT]
q.desc: He brandishes his sword of indignation, the miasma wavering with each swing.

q.n:
Despair of the Cursed Armor X
[ADV]
q.desc: With a bellow of resentment, the thickening smog wraps around him.

q.n:
Despair of the Cursed Armor X
[PRO]
q.desc: He rampages while cloaked in mist. The adventurers are filled with despair.

q.n:
Despair of the Cursed Armor X
[Ultra]
q.desc: The red metal becomes hatred incarnate, casting fear and destruction over the world.

dungeons.n: PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 1 -The Bullet of Doom

q.desc: The story begins in an idyllic town caressed by the sun's warm rays and the gentle winds of spring.
The youthful teacher's bright smile brings joy to both her students and the town.
Though beast attacks are not uncommon, there was something strange about this recent one.
The town is defended by a group of skilled fighters prepared to risk life and limb when the need arises.
There is something special about being young and staying up late to talk about hopes and dreams.
No one can mention him without flashing a proud grin.
Birth, growth, death. Nature repeats itself in a sacred, never-ending cycle.
The path to adulthood is paved with mistakes and bruises, but it always continues ahead.
He did not realize it was a turning point until after making his choice.
Someone once told him that even though people die eventually, they must always move forward.
Books empower me. They give me thoughts without limits-- wings of freedom.
Follow your own path. Abandon your doubts and hesitation, and push forward.
One must take the lives of others to survive. That is the reason they have fangs.
That boundary was not meant to be crossed. Tempers flare. The monster roars.
If four people aren't enough, gather another four. Cross blades with a mighty foe!
Get Awesome Rewards by playing once a day!

dungeons.n: That Time I Summoned a SLIME on Christmas Eve!

q.desc: Rayas is surprised to meet Rimuru & friends again. They all head to the Firecat's Den to catch up.
Rayas' visitors smile as they take in the cheerful commotion of the town again.
Rimuru explains why they've returned to Reigrad, but Rayas can't wrap his head around it.
The festival preparations are interrupted when Dolon escapes with a vengeance...
The situation is more dire than everyone thought. They continue to defeat the beasts and search for Dolon.
Dolon has yet to be found even as his sinister plan tortures the townsfolk.
Dolon sneers fearlessly from the shadows. Meanwhile, Rayas' group fights on.
The beasts attack with baffling movements. Rimuru notices something and rushes to his allies.
The four food storerooms are key points. Rimuru tells everyone the enemy's motive and his counter plan.

q.n: Losing a Battle to Win a War
q.desc: Everyone puts Rimuru's plan into action. Roy and Rimuru split off to find...
Rayas: "Can you help with my training?" Rimuru: "Sure, I'll give you a hand."
Milim: "That looks like fun! Let me join!" Rimuru: "Okay... but make sure to hold back, got it?"
Shion: "May I join your training?" Rayas: "Yeah! Let's go all out!"
