dungeons.n: That Time I Summoned a SLIME for New Years!

q.desc: Rimuru & friends helped prevent the worst. However, there is still much to be done.
With Dolon's escape, the city's food stores have been devastated.
Roy discusses what he knows to make sure the new year dawns peacefully.
Everyone has their own role in gathering ingredients for the New Year's feast.
Rimuru heads to the forge to visit Giliam. Someone unexpected awaits there!
Forte, the Shadow Guardian, has brought her troops. There could be no better allies to have!
Life Beryl, an ore filled with mysteries. What powers does it hold?
The team is working hard for their food. Veggies, fish, meat... Little by little, the stores are replenished.
Rayas and Milim barely escape the monstrous talons, thanks to the aid of a reliable friend.
The table is heavy with delicacies. It is time to congratulate each other for a job well done!
Rimuru "Hey Rayas, want to keep at it?" Rayas: "You bet! Let's go, Rimuru!"
Milim "That meal has got me itching for some exercise!" Rimuru "Yeah, I'm worried about fitting into my clothes..."
Rayas "H-Hey, how about a break?" Milim "No way! I need to work out more!"
A limited quest with boosted drop rates for crossover equipment. You can do it 5 times a day!
Play this limited-time Quest up to 5 times a day for boosted drop rates on Crossover Equips!
Hart and his friends, though undergraduates, are allowed to join the Rangers and train as apprentices.
Progress comes one step at a time. Eventually, small changes in the surroundings become visible.
Simon is still honored after his passing, and his deeds left a path for others to follow.
Dead men tell no tales, so the living have to search their own memories for answers.
A red rose -- vivid, beautiful, solemn -- continues to watch over her.
The gnawing question of "Why?" continues to swell with the passing years until it fills her heart.
Although they live for the future, she can only speak to them of the past.
Abandonment is a part of life. Profound love and death become shackles around the heart.
Were the tears shed that day those of joy or overflowing sadness?
The yells were like those of someone drowning while the beast's howls echoed through the twilight town.
Skills as sharp as the edge gleaming in her eyes, the one bearing the legend's name approaches.
She swore to defend it all: the town, its people, and her own heart, even as it threatened to burst.
The fall of night was only an illusion. Instead, fiendish curtains of shadow covered the sky.
Its footsteps are the rhythm and its wingflaps the melody. The scaled terror begins to perform a funeral dirge.

dungeons.n: A Diva in a World Without Music

q.desc: Mira is concerned since the spring thaw is much later than usual.
The people of Bamint are distressed by the endlessly howling blizzard.
Rayas finds a lone girl in the castle's courtyard. Her voice is as clear as the watery blue of her hair.
Even the most cherished melodies have suddenly vanished from the memories of all.
They search for the elusive singer, hoping to hear her voice once more.
The mysterious girl speaks solemnly of a plaintive soul's soundless cry.
Below Bamint Castle, a source of promise waits patiently in the gloom.
Bracing themselves against the blinding snowstorm, Rayas and his allies search for the source of the roars.
The frosty peaks come into view. There stands their ruler, the Winter Giant.
Her eyes always shining with hope, Miku sings for a world deprived of music.
Crossover Equipment has a higher chance to drop on this limited once per day quest!
Her song echoes throughout the entire city, melting the hearts of the frigid residents.
When sunlight once again shines over the city, she becomes wrapped in the vibrant color of spring.
The Giant's yawns threaten to freeze the city. Help with his morning exercises to perk him up.
Test your strength! Breaking the Boss is the key to victory!
Tougher foes for tougher wills! Inflict Burn for an advantage!
A truly daunting obstacle! Barriers will only be a burden, so strike with all of your might!
A Giant of disaster appears from the frozen wastes. You must stop the relentless destruction it brings!
The skies are blue, but the red sunset from that day two years ago still lingers in her eyes.
In contrast to the straight path before Priscilla, her thoughts are in a complex tangle.
Both memories of joy and fear mix together, tinting the past in a colorless swirl.
Fate would see her short visit to the capital become much longer than anticipated.
The day Priscilla awaited has finally come. She summons up her courage and makes her stand.
Talent brought him far in a short time, granting him the exact position he needs.
Even a haughty princess with grand ambitions can be a useful stepping stone.
His promotion is practically guaranteed. After all, no one outperformed him in battle.
Nothing ventured, nothing gained. However, precaution is always necessary.
Priscilla would tell him what she decided-- her feelings left unshared for two years.
She is a master with the bow, but her arrows of emotion have trouble finding their mark.
Fully focused, her arrows fly true, piercing her target and the hearts of those watching.
Its twofold roars are filled with rage and grief. Each attack lands with fatal intent.
In that muscular red frame is dauntless anger. In those merciless black eyes are deadly despair.

dungeons.n: PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 4 - Black Steel of Hatred

q.desc: Whether to chase or to flee depends on the subtle movements of fate.
Once the seeds of distrust are sown, they cannot be uprooted easily.
Hart realizes from his unusual perspective that he is watching the memories of another.
Ever since being targeted, Hart cannot shake the sensation he is being watched.
The dream shows Hart her true smile, more beautiful than any flower.
Though Hart tries to ignore that overflowing pain, suffering is plain on his face.
Cloaked by the cover of night, the Mage Corps marches without a sound.
Hart swore his life for the cause, but such zeal can be surprisingly fragile.
Whether to flee or chase depends entirely upon one's own judgment.
That emotion, searing with ferocious intensity... I know it well.
His job is simple: eliminate targets with unerring accuracy.
Once the firing hammer is locked, time and distance vanish.
A roar emerging from the bottomless depths instills the living with despair.
Its maw opens wide. That black void resembles a passageway to the hereafter.

dungeons.n: Spy in the Shadows - Airi's Mission

q.desc: Even as the Arcana Express silently heads for its destination, Valkia's military exercises begin.
Forte's squad trains in fighting aboard a moving vehicle.
The earlier skirmish just a warm-up. After arrival, the training program begins for real.
They once more board the Arcana Express to master the finer points of vehicular warfare.
Forte's unit is amazed by the lavishness of their lodgings.
Little relaxation is had before the abrupt announcement of a nighttime engagement.
After the surprise training, dawn brings more unanticipated events.
With Lyla off to help clear out the avalanche, Forte and Airi practice by themselves.
Forte and Airi spend their break appreciating nature when they have a chance meeting.
The two help the lost monster, but their kindness is not so readily accepted.
Airi: "Let's see who's stronger!"
Airi: "Hah, then I'll go all out too!"
His hatred for Humans may be justified, but that must be quelled before peace can be restored.
Fury towards Humankind has blinded him. Strike with the weight of repentance.
Aged ruins near the imperial capital becomes Hart & Priscilla's new dwelling.
Azvan welcomes Hart as a comrade after noticing a change in his eyes.
The enemy soldier's warning resonates grimly inside Hart's mind.
Mountains of evidence to the contrary cannot still his imagination.
The line between fact and fiction blurs even while awake.
Hart could not help but hate the peaceful look on Simon's lifeless face.
Additional visions reveal both answers and glimpses of her smile.
She swore to stay by his side and support him, but now she is powerless to help.
Lost and confused, Priscilla reaches out in the dark for help.
There is no turning back. He points his gun at the shadow before him.
He also wields that black steel bullet. Sinners cheer as they fall before it.
Anger, fear, regret, hatred. A mixture of emotions swirls behind the twisted bars.
Malice covers the land in the shade of creeping dread.
Howls of despair ring out from the impregnable fortress atop the summit.
Rayas accepts Sophie's request from Ganan and heads for the wilderness.
The forest is teeming with monsters. Rayas fights to make it safe again.
While in the middle of his work. Rayas meets an unusual pair.
Rayas leads Asakura Yoh and Kyoyama Anna back to Reigrad.
With an easygoing smile, Yoh tells Rayas that anyone who can see spirits must be a decent person.
Rayas takes a small party to the mountains to find the crystals needed to send Yoh and Anna back home.
Once the group reaches the mountain cave, they soon discover it is a den of monsters.
With Mira's support, the party collects the crystals while keeping the monsters at bay.
Rayas and crew have enough crystals. The only problem now is if Rem's alchemy will work.
Returning safely to Reigrad, Rayas, Roy and Yoh bring the stones to Rem so she can begin the preparations.
I'm the goddess of victory that'll lead Yoh to becoming the Shaman King.
Once you think you're going to lose, the battle's already lost.
Observe the true powers of mystic arts from another world.
Mastercraft material has a chance to drop on this challenging five times per day quest!
While waiting for Rem to prepare, Rayas suggests taking Yoh and Anna to join the Battle Tournament.
To reach the Battle Tournament, the group has to pass through both field and forest.
Rayas and crew continue through the Isliid Plains and meet a surprising person.
After reuniting with Tao Ren, everyone continues towards the Battle Tournament.
While Rem continues her preparations, Ganan comes looking for Rayas with an urgent request.
Rayas and crew leave the plains and enter the forest. However, they soon realize that things are unusual.
Rayas, confused by the monsters' strange behavior, learn that the likely issue is none other than Yoh's rival.
Someone calling himself the Future King is spreading havoc in the city hosting the Battle Tournament.
Leaving the forest, Rayas's group finds their destination close at hand.
Rayas reaches the Battle Tournament arena and is shocked by flames he has never seen before.
I'm more than a match for you.
Having too much power is painful in its own way...
I'll put you to rest. No one can stand against the Spirit of Fire.
Muster all your strength and place high in the rankings!
Mastercraft material has a chance to drop on this challenging five times per day quest!

dungeons.n: Spy in the Shadows - Lyla's Mission

q.desc: With the unexpected crisis settled, the army's program continues along the beach.
Lyla's expression darkens after hearing the next portion will take place at sea.
A lone figure pensively looks over the water the night before naval maneuvers begin.
Threats both normal and abnormal convince the army to spend more time off-shore.
During a short break, Airi gives Lyla some advice and a small present.
Lyla stares at the seashell from Airi while recalling her past.
As everyone gets their sea legs, they must remember not to become careless.
Memories of that shipwreck investigation still haunt Lyla.
Lyla, no more than a rookie, stumbles through a desperate situation.
As the soldiers clear out monsters in the wreckage, they notice something strange.
Lyla: "Would you like to have a mock duel?"
Lyla: "This time, I will fight with all I have!"
It appears from the eternal mists, severing the bond between soul and vessel.
The reaper laughs coldly as the living struggle against it. Shine a light through the despair.
KoB Summer Limited Daily Quest! Challenge every day and get awesome rewards!

dungeons.n: Grimm Stella & the Great Six Witches Chapter I

q.desc: Thousands upon thousands of books draw all manner of people with all manner of interests.
She comes and goes with little warning, restlessly searching.
Rayas returns to his reading, but he soon finds himself observing the story firsthand.
A shared interest can unite people and resolve conflict, even if that interest happens to be fictional.
No one knew what happened to the chosen ones until it was too late.
While Rayas is saddled with frustration, a pair holding unusual powers approaches him.
The one who altered the book and their purpose for doing so are yet wrapped in mystery.
A beast suddenly attacks as the Alter Scar fades. It must be destroyed to fully undo the damage.
The book hinted at Elizabeth's journey after she gave the Pillars her blood.
Awakening from the dream, Rayas discovers the story took an unexpected twist.
Burdened with a miserable fate, she dreams of changing her dark past into a brilliant future.
Released from a miserable fate, her eyes are locked onto the distant, brilliant future.
Oppressive fear from its mighty roar makes one wish everything were a dream.
When its jaws open wide and its eyes close shut, the nightmare will come to a tragic end.
She departed from the village as he stayed behind to walk his own path.
Focus and discipline kept that ever-present loneliness at bay.
No matter which comes first, the bad usually overshadows the good.
The scope of the charges against Hart made Vultee's blood run cold.
He could never turn his back on his home, but that was why he needed to leave it.
He recalls younger days when rarely one passed without her weeping.
Whoever wanders into this restricted zone is unlikely to leave it alive.
Though the years sapped strength from his body, they also honed his skills.
An unexpected remark brings Vultee closer to the truth.
Her eyes dyed a dull violet told him the vivid days of his youth were no more.
Duty burns in his heart as brightly as the muzzle flashes of his gun.
Hoping to return to lost times, he charges once more into the fray with his trusty sidearm.
He won't ask forgiveness, only sympathy. That warped emotion still writhes within.
Insanity gnaws away at what keeps his heart from sinking deeper into the darkness.

dungeons.n: Going All Out in Isliid Part 1

q.desc: Rayas, gravely wounded, is saved by an unfamiliar boy.
Rayas explains to Rudeus and Eris how he ended up falling from the sky.
Rayas figures out what caused him to Summon two people from a completely different world
Determined to protect his young visitors, Rayas fights the wild monsters.
Despite Rayas' efforts, the endless horde of beasts seems impossible to overcome alone...
Rayas couldn't hide his surprise after hearing Rudeus started studying magic at a tender age.
The conversation turns to Rudeus' master who tutored him in the finer points of spellcasting.
Rudeus' hard work combined with his natural gift have already shown astounding results.
Rayas suggests going back to Reigrad in order to return Rudeus and Eris to their world.
The Demons' airship soars overhead, its destination all too obvious...
First, we'll start with the basics of magic.
It seems that there might be some merit to training this one after all.
Two magicians from another world demonstrate their remarkable skill.

dungeons.n: Going All Out in Isliid Part 2

q.desc: Rayas and the others head for the Demons' airship, feeling the excitement before the battle.
Grad and Nier make the first move by unleashing their new arsenal upon Rayas' group.
Virago's wealth of experience lets him effortlessly avoid the enemy assault.
Unable to stop Rayas' approach, the Demons grow nervous.
After maneuvering through numerous attacks, Rayas and his party arrive on the deck of the airship.
The Demons are caught in Rudeus' trap, giving Rayas the perfect opportunity to strike.
The battle appears to come to an end as Grad and Nier admit defeat.
Rayas' party is scattered by the shock wave of the explosion.
Rayas fumbles for a solution to stop from crashing to the ground again.
As the group recovers from their wounds, Reigrad is engulfed by fire.
Good enough to be able to protect Rudy... That's how strong I need to be!
I'm ready to go anytime! Hit me with everything you got!
The Demon's airship descends upon Reigrad. Repel it at any cost!
I need to keep working hard just like those kids! Rayas overflows with motivation.
Mastercraft material has a chance to drop from this challenging five-times-daily quest!
Whether by fate or by choice, two friends now clash in battle.
Though people change, some things remain unchanged, or so they believe.
Invisible strings force the doll to dance at the will of another.
He receives a brief glimpse of a plausible yet unlikely outcome.
The hands of time, even in peace, always urge action.
Destiny's link between lovers holds tight... even if stained red.
She only wants to protect him, but that won't bring her happiness.
She tried her best to ignore it, though it was inside her all along.
Her piercing attack is unleashed, more than enough to destroy any target.
Suffering, struggle, and anger. This was not the happy ending she imagined.
I kill to protect. I destroy to defend. See how easily I can end a life.
Beautiful memories ate away at my heart. I am what remains.
Her tears called the beast. It knows about love... and its futility.
Suffering, pain, sadness, envy. They act as the perfect fuel.

dungeons.n: PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 8 - Spiral of Sin

q.desc: Combat was supposed to be only means to an end, but he became addicted to the rush.
Through his mental fog, he sees them shine as bright and numerous as the stars.
To shoot in an instant, without hesitation. That was the base requirement to be a sniper.
He never expected he would have to run, but he never expected failure either.
The town remained unchanged. The only difference was her absence.
He wanted to know the next part of the story as much as he feared it.
That day, the rampart would be stained in a red deeper than the sunset.
Whoever these memories belong to, I know for sure the anger is my own.
Their roads have converged for the last time.
Consequences are unavoidable. Sin begets itself to build a twisting chain, then...
The iron hulk groans with its perpetrated crimes each time the trigger is pulled.
If a single bullet is terrifying, six from point blank in rapid succession is nightmarish.
The giant sneers at the puny things underfoot. He knows he alone is supreme.
His hammer is in itself a force of nature. The ground shudders beneath its might.

The Giant of disaster bellows, shaking the mountain. Fighters at its feet shiver not from cold, but fear.
The black wings cast a shadow that blocks out not just light, but hope as well.
In a strange twist of fate, the same mission shows up in two different worlds.
Rayas is looking for a challenge. Ganan gives him just what he wants.
The Wizards of Fairy Tail were pulled into the light, unaware of their destination.
Rayas and Roy take the monster-slaying quest in hopes to get some solid training.
The beasts are fast and unpredictable, outpacing even word of mouth.
As Rayas' group enters the forest, a thick mist envelops them...
The wizards find themselves in an unfamiliar setting...and under attack.
Though outnumbered, the otherworld wizards fight boldly.
Rayas' party comes running to find some surprising new faces.
Believing the request's completion will send them back, the wizards join the battle.
Natsu: "I'm burning to fight!"
Lucy: "Get ready to lose!"
Natsu: "Can you handle the heat?" Lucy: "You better get serious!"
Natsu: "I'm not done yet!" Lucy: "The real battle starts now."
The two Guilds chase the fleeing monsters, determined to complete the Quest.
Plenty of challengers lured by the sizable reward have joined the fight.
The crowd of swaggering ruffians proves to be more hindrance than help.
Rayas' party splits up to fight the beasts. Natsu and Gray fall into their usual competitive routine.
The monsters are beset by powerful magic techniques, giving little opportunity to the bumbling rogues.
The visitors to Raktehelm possess an incredible array of mystical abilities.
Fairy Tail has nearly defeated the beasts, but not everyone is pleased...
The enraged ruffians attack to steal back their lost prize.
Pride and greed have blinded the thugs to the obvious difference in power.
The two Guilds celebrate their victory even as an angry crowd tries to beat down their door.
Gray: "You're no match for me."
Erza: "Do battle with honor."
Gray: "I'll show you real ice magic." Erza: "I accept your challenge."
Defeat 10 enemies or more within the time limit!
Gray: "Time to settle the score." Erza: "Don't blame me if you get hurt."
The Hero of Famelle's granddaughter Charlotte is dealing with the trials of adolescence.
The young knight charges forward to solve the mysterious monster invasion.
Charlotte shows off the swordplay she has learned underneath the Hero of Famelle's tutelage.
The two mismatched girls remind Rayas of him and his own childhood friend.
Even the most cheerful and openhearted person has at least a couple of inner conflicts.
Since she carries his blood in her veins, she is also determined to uphold his legacy.
Although their hearts are in the right place, their words are clumsy and unclear.
She thinks no one understands her, but she also doesn't know what she wants them to understand.
The lonely girl takes the long way home. Her heart mirrors the sun sinking below the horizon.
From the very first day she took hold of its hilt, purpose ignited within her soul.
Her small frame holds great bravery. Duel against the royal knight Charlotte.
She continues her training to become stronger -- strong enough to protect those she loves.
The black edge emerges from the void, beckoning towards the world beyond life.
She has inherited all she needs: his lineage, his technique, and his will.
The armor fights with trance-like instinct. He exists alongside Shinobi history.
Wordlessly, he unleashes his true might. Facing him demands full focus.

dungeons.n: New Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll Act 1

q.desc: Slipping past his attendant, Mizuki the Twelfth, leader of Imari Village, sneaks off into town.
Fine garments, glistening canals, and unwavering lights -- this restless place never skips a beat.

q.n: Drawing in the Threads of Fate
q.desc: The performance captivates the masses. Before he knew it, Mizuki was drawn in as well.
Demon and shinobi are both bound by restraints. In spite, or because, of this, the two become intertwined.
Kokuri, the outsider. Kokuri, the hindrance. Kokuri, the crisis. Kokuri, the hope.
Bathing in the warm waters reminds them of what it feels like to be alive.
The broken seal granted neither answers nor mementos of past suffering.
"I don't want to change." That simple wish began to slowly change the world.
The ominous legend sealed off in a distant ethereal realm lives on even today...
Conquer the trial and transcend generations of history.
Mizuki faces the wall that is Ginzo. When his powers blossom...
Vast might inherited by a fitting vessel. However, it remains incomplete.
That armor is infused with the blood and sweat of the shinobi, growing stronger with each generation.
Overcoming that wall became a rite of passage. Conquer death, for what truly matters lies beyond.
Rayas drops by the Adventurers' Guild and finds his boss wearing a grim expression.
A boy named Takemichi Hanagaki says he came from another world.
Takemichi goes over the events leading up to his meeting with Rayas.
Rayas protects the unarmed Takemichi from a throng of vicious creatures.
After slaying the last beast, Rayas can finally breathe easy...
The impressed Rayas carries Takemichi back to town to care for his wounds.
Rayas nears the edge of the monsters' turf. Safety awaits in the town up ahead.
Going to the knoll Takemichi mentioned, Rayas spots another boy in trouble.
Rayas stumbles ahead, thankful he can rely on the boy named Mitsuya next to him.
After returning to Reigrad, Rayas and Mitsuya check on Takemichi's condition.
Mitsuya: "Better get yourself pumped up!"
Mikey: "You wanna die that bad?"

Rayas comes across a patrol unit, giving a valuable hint to his destination.
The party discovers their enemies are more than willing to welcome them.
A massive foe looms before Rayas and his allies.
The Giant has greater strength than Rayas expected.
Toman's Vice Leader Draken blows away the hulking monster with a single punch.
Draken unleashes another mighty blow against the Giant...
The monsters' commander appears, far stronger than his brother.
The gang faces off against the mastermind and his wild ambitions.
Brought to their knees by the Giant's power, the party struggles to turn the tide...
Chifuyu: Mess around and find out.

dungeons.n: New Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll Act 2

q.desc: A sweet fragrance drifting through the village marks the long-awaited season.
Unseen restraints coil and weave, stronger than shackles of any metal.
Knotted worries unfurl in the springs. The shinobi cherish those healing waters.
She questions why she still feels tremors despite clinging so tight.
The heavy dampness in the air is not from the evening shower.
She drifts between duty and belief, unable to decide.
Formless unease gives way to a clear path.
The path was narrow and delicate, yet a strange confidence filled her.
An untold future lies ahead, its dangers waiting to be revealed.
One drop sets change in motion. A ripple becomes a wave.
Imari's resident trainer, well versed in the ways of the shinobi.
As beautiful as mist in the morning light, she stands waiting.
Breath shines like silk, yet it steals the life from whatever it envelops.
Walking the path of the shinobi may bring you to her.

Garm Vs. Mega Mikyuon! Find out who wins this merciless monster battle!
The raging Phoenix, swathed in fulgent blazes, is a spectacle never meant to be witnessed.
A mysterious structure that resembles a La Riiz fort suddenly appears near Reigrad.
To protect the town, Rayas and his allies fight the machines of war.
They meet a strange trio deeper inside the fortress, unsure if they are friend or foe.
The three Hemiteos Units join Rayas' battle against the mechanical drones.
Mira cannot hide her unease towards the three otherworldly soldiers.
The feelings of doubt are mutual as Strength reveals thoughts similar to Mira's.
Although the party has made considerable progress, Rayas suggests leaving to rest up.
The girls are hesitant but help out the refugees. As Mira watches, she has a change of heart.
Through their volunteer efforts, both sides finally realize they can trust each other.
The party returns to the fortress. In the deepest part, they find a huge enemy awaiting them.
Empress: "...OK, let's do it."
Dead Master: "Is it my turn?"
Strength: "Time to bust some heads!"
Face off against the visitors from another world!
Charlotte destroyed the heart of the matter...or so it seemed.
Valerie doggedly searches the town, but her prized possession is nowhere to be found.
She checked the school, the fields, and even the roads. All that remains is...
Rayas, unable to shake the foreboding sensation, seeks Zeorg for advice.
Only one person in all of Famelle notices Valerie's unusual mood.
After hearing Rayas' report, Zeorg draws upon his experience to make a sound decision.
Charlotte and Valerie's friendship was by no means a coincidence.
The two girls look upwards into the endless blue world.
Valerie's heart, filled to the brim with dark feelings, finally overflows.
One has it all. The other does not. Even the best of friends could not ignore this difference forever.
The striking azure of her keen blade can freeze the strongest opponents in their tracks.
Trained by a living legend, she pierces through absolute zero like a falling star.
Anguished souls are like fine delicacies. Their screams provide the perfect accompaniment.
The indelible fact of suffering will never change so long as life exists.

Reflected in the glint of his eyes is the ultimate form of shinobi arts.
His wrath borders on supernatural. The deadly blade strikes without hesitance.

dungeons.n: New Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll Act 3

q.desc: A gentle traveler with unrivaled looks finds refuge in a welcoming village.
Flames suddenly envelop the village, turning it into a hellish landscape.
Scoundrels, fanatics, and gentle hearts alike. Each of them shares the same gift of life.
Humans were denounced as weak by the legends. As true as that was, they flourished the greatest.
Live an empty life and slowly wane or burn bright before fading. The choice is yours.
Kirisame faces the incarnation of insanity. On that visage was carved a subtle smirk.
He toys with lives with acute disregard. Just what hides behind that cold countenance?
A deathly aura descends upon the village. Eliminate it or be completely enveloped.
Flames surge up from all around as embers dance in the frenzied air.
Believe in your feelings and choose your own path. Firmly grasp those thoughts and advance.
When one's life force peters out, the reaper swoops in on howling winds.
Turn away from that shadow, lest you be whisked away to peril.
Once a caretaker for the doomed, he now brings about the anguish of death.
One swing of the scythe spells disaster. Objecting to this fate will not be tolerated.

dungeons.n: New Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll Act 4

q.desc: The aftermath of that world-changing event slowly takes shape.
To share and enjoy life's pleasures was apparently seen as greed by some.
Winds of change cause a cold heart to falter. Such conflict may rouse fires of emotion.
Everyone has a devilish side. Fear it, tame it, or succumb.
Mizuki blazes headlong into battle, seeking what lies under his charred remains.
Kokuri is smothered by the smell of death floating in on a tepid breeze.
Each attempt makes another crack in that insurmountable obstacle.
Imari begins to tremble under the dire situation as the moon watches in silence.
He struggled to break down those walls, unaware of who made them.
The decisive battle concludes...just before the sinister being of yore revives.
The apparition awakens but has yet to recover its full strength.
That vile fox relishes in the anguish and fears of the people.
A dangerous scroll heedfully passed down from bygone ages. Utter the words and witness evil's rebirth.
The moon sneers as it casts its eerie light. Stare in awe of the devourer of the weak.
Get awesome rewards by playing once a day!
Demons plot to free a dangerous creature trapped by the Great Six Demons.
Clouds gather over the fields of Isliid as strange ruins emerge from the sea.
The monster hidden in the border between worlds holds power beyond imagination.
Ainz continues the search for lost comrades. He prepares to warp into town, but suddenly...
Behind the fabled doors, Nier and Grad find a sorcerer from another realm.
Rayas' group arrive at the strange building. Its walls tremble from mighty roars.
When an enigmatic monster assaults the party, Rayas tries to Summon help.
The heroes which answer Rayas' call are far stronger than anyone expected.
The Summons then bare their fangs at Rayas, who is bewildered by their actions.
The next ruler of Demonkind has been named: Ainz Ooal Gown.
From the boiling magma, a dragon bursts forth with malicious force.
As the dragon's breath caresses the ground, it instantly turns into black ash.
Its seething rage will not be calmed until the entire world has been consumed by fire.
Test your limits and rank as high as you can!
Rayas instinctually knows he cannot withstand the spell Ainz is about to unleash.
Assumed destroyed, that strange monster reemerges with a hunger for Ainz's power.
Ainz reveals his full potential against an inscrutable foe.
Although abandoned by Nier and Grad, Ainz finds he does not have to fight alone.
It absorbs all magic to convert into strength. Defeating it will take more cunning than force.
Ainz realizes that the only means of defeating the monster is his ultimate resort.
Afraid of exposing Rayas' group to the fatal effects, Ainz lets the perfect opportunity escape.
Ainz's attempts at cooperation do not go as smoothly as he hopes.
Two demons descend from the skies. Their presence turns the tide of battle.
Ainz and his minions act in flawless harmony. At last, the struggle is over...
Unleashed upon Raktehelm once more, it desires only to bring disaster.
It stands again and again. Options rapidly dwindle.
The evil beast attacks, ravaging time and space. Only death remains in its wake.

q.desc: Mizuki triumphs as a new chain of events are set in motion.
Pain tears through Hazuki as fate hints at an abrupt end to her way of life.
Ena, land of prosperity and decline, is no more, yet its untold history hides the truth.
Never stop asking questions, no matter how unpleasant the response.
Hakuro and Hazuki both had difficult pasts, resulting in a complex relationship.
His sinister utterings permeate the quiet city streets.
